title: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding
title_zh: VideoEvolve: Co-Evolving Memory and Retrieval for Long Video Understanding

paragraphs.en: Long video understanding increasingly relies on external memory to organize massive visual streams into compact representations. However, most memory-based methods dynamically adapt how information is retrieved for different questions, while largely fixing what is remembered. This mismatch makes missing details costly to recover, whereas stored information is valuable only when it can be reliably retrieved. To address this issue, we propose VideoEvolve, a novel self-evolving framework that jointly evolves memory and retrieval for long video understanding. Specifically, starting from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, VideoEvolve couples a Memory Evolver for selective memory augmentation with a Retrieval Evolver for adaptive retrieval over the evolving memory. We then co-evolve the two Evolvers through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL), updating one while freezing the other. To steer this alternating evolution, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) identifies whether the current bottleneck lies in memory or retrieval and directs optimization toward the more limiting side. Furthermore, VideoEvolve introduces Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) to alleviate downstream feedback from over-specializing memory to a fixed set of training questions, shifting training toward underdeveloped yet learnable video capabilities. By integrating Agentic RL with BEF and CEF, VideoEvolve transforms downstream reasoning experience into transferable capability updates, providing a concrete path from static long-video systems toward experience-driven, self-improving multimodal intelligence. Extensive experiments on multiple long video understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoEvolve.
paragraphs.zh: 长视频理解越来越依赖外部记忆，将海量视觉流组织为紧凑的表示。 然而，大多数基于记忆的方法会针对不同问题动态调整信息检索方式，但记忆内容本身却基本固定不变。 这种不匹配使得缺失的细节难以恢复，而存储的信息只有在能够可靠检索时才有价值。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 VideoEvolve——一种新颖的自我进化框架，可协同进化记忆与检索机制，以支持长视频理解。 具体而言，VideoEvolve 从一个粗略的低帧率概览出发，结合了一个用于选择性增强记忆的“记忆进化器”和一个在动态变化的记忆中执行自适应检索的“检索进化器”。 接着，我们通过交替的智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）协同进化这两个“进化器”，每次更新其中一个的同时冻结另一个。 为了引导这种交替进化，我们设计了“瓶颈感知进化反馈”（BEF），用于判断当前瓶颈是出现在记忆还是检索环节，并将优化方向指向更受限的一方。 此外，VideoEvolve 引入了“能力感知进化反馈”（CEF），以防止下游反馈导致记忆机制过度特化于固定的训练问题集，从而将训练重点转向尚未充分发展但具备学习潜力的视频能力。 通过将智能体强化学习与 BEF 和 CEF 相整合，VideoEvolve 将下游推理经验转化为可迁移的能力更新，为从静态长视频系统向以经验驱动、自我提升的多模态智能演进提供了具体路径。 在多个长视频理解基准数据集上进行的广泛实验验证了 VideoEvolve 的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Long video understanding remains challenging for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), as task-relevant evidence is often sparsely distributed within videos that can last over an hour, while exhaustive visual processing incurs substantial computational costs ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . To address this challenge, recent agentic Video-MLLMs adopt two representative paradigms for selective information access: Video-Revisiting Methods , which localize and revisit question-relevant video segments to recover fine-grained visual evidence ( Ding et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) ; and Memory-Based Methods , which organize video content into persistent memory and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence from this compact representation ( Song et al., 2024 ; Yeo et al., 2026 ) . By reusing stored information across questions, memory-based methods offer a scalable approach to long video understanding, with the quality of memory construction shaping the evidence available for subsequent retrieval and reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 对于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）而言，长视频理解仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为与任务相关的证据往往稀疏地分布在可能长达一个小时的视频中，而全面的视觉处理则会带来巨大的计算成本（Wu et al., 2024；Fu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025c）。 为应对这一挑战，近期的智能体式视频-MLLMs 采用了两种典型的范式来实现选择性信息访问：视频重访方法，即定位并重访与问题相关的视频片段以恢复精细的视觉证据（Ding et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026a）；以及基于记忆的方法，即将视频内容组织成持久性记忆，并从这种紧凑的表示中自适应地检索相关证据（Song et al., 2024；Yeo et al., 2026）。 通过在多个问题间复用已存储的信息，基于记忆的方法为长视频理解提供了一种可扩展的方案，而记忆构建的质量则决定了后续检索和推理所可用的证据质量。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advantages, existing memory-based methods largely follow a one-way adaptation paradigm (Figure 1 (a)), with two related limitations. (1) Limited Memory Adaptability : predefined construction policies rarely learn from downstream reasoning feedback ( Yeo et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) , so omitted evidence can repeatedly force costly raw-video revisits. (2) Memory–Retrieval Misalignment : construction and retrieval are typically optimized separately ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly aligning what memory preserves with what retrieval can effectively access. This raises our central question: can memory construction and retrieval learn to improve each other, enabling co-evolution of what to remember and how to retrieve?
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些优势，现有的基于记忆的方法大多遵循单向适应范式（图 1 (a)），并由此带来两个相关的局限性。 (1) 记忆适应能力有限：预定义的构建策略很少能从下游推理反馈中学习（Yeo et al., 2026; Choi et al., 2026），因此被遗漏的证据可能反复迫使系统重新查看成本高昂的原始视频。 (2) 记忆与检索的不匹配：构建和检索通常被分别优化（Yang et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2026），并未明确对齐记忆所保留的内容与检索能够有效访问的内容。 这引出了我们的核心问题：记忆构建与检索能否相互促进，从而实现“记住什么”与“如何检索”的协同进化？

sents.en: (2) Memory–Retrieval Misalignment : construction and retrieval are typically optimized separately ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly aligning what memory preserves with what retrieval can effectively access.
sents.zh: (2) 记忆与检索的不匹配：构建和检索通常被分别优化（Yang et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2026），并未明确对齐记忆所保留的内容与检索能够有效访问的内容。

sents.en: This raises our central question: can memory construction and retrieval learn to improve each other, enabling co-evolution of what to remember and how to retrieve?
sents.zh: 这引出了我们的核心问题：记忆构建与检索能否相互促进，从而实现“记住什么”与“如何检索”的协同进化？

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we propose VideoEvolve (Figure 1 (b)), a self-evolving framework that co-evolves memory construction and retrieval policies through alternating agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) . Starting from a reusable memory built from low-frame-rate video observations, the Memory Evolver learns to selectively augment stored evidence, while the Retrieval Evolver learns to search the evolving memory and revisit the raw video when needed. With the Retrieval Evolver frozen, downstream reasoning feedback guides the Memory Evolver to improve memory construction; the Retrieval Evolver is then optimized over the updated, fixed memory. This alternating process aligns what the system remembers with how it retrieves. To guide subsequent cycles, Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) compares memory-only and revisit-enabled reasoning, accounting for actual video revisits, to estimate the relative training needs of the two Evolvers and direct optimization toward the more limiting side.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这个问题，我们提出了 VideoEvolve（图 1(b)），这是一个自我演化的框架，通过交替的智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）共同演化记忆构建和检索策略。 从基于低帧率视频观察构建的可复用记忆出发，记忆演化器学会选择性地增强已存储的证据，而检索演化器则学会在演化的记忆中搜索，并在必要时重新查看原始视频。 在固定检索演化器的情况下，下游推理反馈会引导记忆演化器改进记忆构建；随后，检索演化器将在更新后的固定记忆上进行优化。 这种交替过程使系统所记住的内容与其检索方式保持一致。 为了指导后续循环，瓶颈感知演化反馈（BEF）会对比仅使用记忆和允许重新查看视频时的推理结果，并考虑实际的视频重新查看情况，以评估两个演化器相对的训练需求，并将优化方向指向更具限制性的那一方。

paragraphs.en: While BEF allocates training effort according to the current memory–retrieval bottleneck, this allocation alone does not ensure the broad capability development required for generalizable long video understanding ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . Repeated optimization on a fixed set of training questions may instead encourage question-specific specialization, motivating capability-level guidance for the co-evolution process. To address this issue, we introduce Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) , which translates capability-level feedback into an adaptive training curriculum. Specifically, CEF reweights training toward underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities while preserving broad coverage, and adjusts the sampling distribution as the two Evolvers improve. By integrating bottleneck-aware resource allocation with capability-aware curriculum adaptation, VideoEvolve supports targeted and transferable co-evolution of memory and retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 BEF 根据当前的记忆–检索瓶颈分配训练资源，但仅靠这种分配无法确保实现通用化长视频理解所需的全方位能力发展（Fu et al., 2026）。 在固定训练问题上重复进行优化，反而可能促使模型形成针对特定问题的专业化倾向，因此有必要通过能力层面的指导来推动协同进化过程。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了“能力感知进化反馈”（CEF），它能够将能力层面的反馈转化为自适应的训练课程。 具体而言，CEF 会重新调整训练权重，将资源更多投向尚未充分发展但具备学习潜力的能力，同时保持广泛覆盖，并随着两个进化器的改进动态调整采样分布。 通过将瓶颈感知的资源分配与能力感知的课程适应相结合，VideoEvolve 支持记忆与检索能力的目标化、可迁移的协同进化。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: (1) We propose VideoEvolve, a self-evolving framework that co-evolves memory construction and retrieval through alternating Agentic RL, enabling both policies to improve from downstream reasoning feedback. (2) We introduce Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) and Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF), which respectively adapt training allocation to memory–retrieval bottlenecks and adjust the training curriculum toward underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities. (3) Experiments on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and MMVU ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) show that VideoEvolve consistently outperforms the evaluated state-of-the-art open-source baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：(1) 我们提出了 VideoEvolve，一个自我演化的框架，它通过交替执行智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）来协同演化记忆构建与检索，使两种策略都能从下游推理反馈中获益并得到提升。 (2) 我们引入了瓶颈感知演化反馈（BEF）和能力感知演化反馈（CEF），它们分别将训练资源分配适配于记忆–检索环节中的瓶颈，并根据尚未充分发展但具备学习潜力的能力来调整训练课程。 (3) 在 Video-MME（Fu et al., 2025）、LongVideoBench（Wu et al., 2024）、LVBench（Wang et al., 2025c）、MLVU（Zhou et al., 2025）和 MMVU（Zhao et al., 2025）上的实验表明，VideoEvolve 在评估中持续优于所有当前最先进的开源基线模型。

sents.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: (1) We propose VideoEvolve, a self-evolving framework that co-evolves memory construction and retrieval through alternating Agentic RL, enabling both policies to improve from downstream reasoning feedback.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：(1) 我们提出了 VideoEvolve，一个自我演化的框架，它通过交替执行智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）来协同演化记忆构建与检索，使两种策略都能从下游推理反馈中获益并得到提升。

sents.en: (2) We introduce Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) and Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF), which respectively adapt training allocation to memory–retrieval bottlenecks and adjust the training curriculum toward underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities.
sents.zh: (2) 我们引入了瓶颈感知演化反馈（BEF）和能力感知演化反馈（CEF），它们分别将训练资源分配适配于记忆–检索环节中的瓶颈，并根据尚未充分发展但具备学习潜力的能力来调整训练课程。

sents.en: (3) Experiments on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and MMVU ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) show that VideoEvolve consistently outperforms the evaluated state-of-the-art open-source baselines.
sents.zh: (3) 在 Video-MME（Fu et al., 2025）、LongVideoBench（Wu et al., 2024）、LVBench（Wang et al., 2025c）、MLVU（Zhou et al., 2025）和 MMVU（Zhao et al., 2025）上的实验表明，VideoEvolve 在评估中持续优于所有当前最先进的开源基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Long Video Understanding with MLLMs. Recent MLLMs have extended video understanding toward longer temporal contexts through time-aware modeling, long-context scaling, and adaptive visual compression ( Ren et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . Beyond directly processing more visual tokens, another line of work shifts toward selective and agentic video access. VideoAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) iteratively retrieves task-relevant visual information, DVD ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) performs autonomous search over multi-granular video databases, and LVAgent ( Chen et al., 2025a ) introduces multi-round collaboration among MLLM agents. More recent approaches further combine active video inspection with reinforcement learning: VideoZoomer ( Ding et al., 2026 ) learns coarse-to-fine temporal focusing, while VITAL ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , LongVT ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , and Ego-R1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) train agents to dynamically invoke visual or retrieval tools for long-horizon reasoning. In summary, these methods primarily improve where and when to inspect the source video, while our work focuses on the complementary question of what should be persistently remembered for subsequent retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 基于多模态大语言模型的长视频理解。 近期的多模态大语言模型通过时间感知建模、长上下文扩展和自适应视觉压缩，将视频理解能力延伸至更长的时间语境（Ren et al., 2024；Shen et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025b）。 除了直接处理更多视觉标记外，另一条研究路线转向了选择性和智能体驱动的视频访问方式。 VideoAgent（Wang et al., 2024）可迭代检索任务相关的视觉信息，DVD（Zhang et al., 2026c）可在多粒度视频数据库中执行自主搜索，而LVAgent（Chen et al., 2025a）则引入了多轮次协作的多模态大语言模型智能体机制。 更近期的方法进一步将主动视频检查与强化学习相结合：VideoZoomer（Ding et al., 2026）能够学习从粗略到精细的时间聚焦策略，而VITAL（Zhang et al., 2026b）、LongVT（Yang et al., 2026a）和Ego-R1（Tian et al., 2026）则训练智能体动态调用视觉或检索工具以进行长期推理。 总而言之，这些方法主要优化了检查源视频的位置与时间，而我们的工作则聚焦于一个互补性问题：哪些信息应被持续记忆以便后续检索。

paragraphs.en: Memory-Based Long Video Understanding. Memory-based approaches retain video evidence for reuse across questions or as question-specific working memory. MovieChat and MA-LMM introduce sparse and online memory mechanisms ( Song et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . EgoRAG organizes captions into hierarchical textual memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , while HippoMM consolidates audiovisual events and combines summary retrieval with detailed recall ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . WorldMM ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) and MERIT ( Choi et al., 2026 ) construct and retrieve explicit memories using pretrained models without method-specific parameter updates. Training-based approaches include M3-Agent’s separately trained memorization and control models ( Long et al., 2026 ) , MemVid’s memory-grounded clue generation optimized through SFT and DPO ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) , and Ego-R1’s learned tool controller over hierarchical memory ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . VideoEvolve focuses on alternating the optimization of memory construction and retrieval policies, while keeping the constructed memory reusable across questions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于记忆的长视频理解。 基于记忆的方法会保留视频证据，以便在不同问题中重复使用，或作为特定问题的工作记忆。 MovieChat 和 MA-LMM 引入了稀疏在线记忆机制（Song et al., 2024；He et al., 2024）。 EgoRAG 将字幕组织为分层文本记忆（Yang et al., 2025），而 HippoMM 则整合视听事件，并结合摘要检索与细节回忆（Lin et al., 2026）。 WorldMM（Yeo et al., 2026）和 MERIT（Choi et al., 2026）利用预训练模型构建并检索显式记忆，无需针对特定方法更新参数。 基于训练的方法包括 M3-Agent 中分别训练的记忆与控制模型（Long et al., 2026）、MemVid 通过 SFT 和 DPO 优化的基于记忆的线索生成机制（Yuan et al., 2025），以及 Ego-R1 在分层记忆上训练的工具控制器（Tian et al., 2026）。 VideoEvolve 专注于交替优化记忆构建与检索策略，同时确保所构建的记忆可在不同问题间重复使用。

paragraphs.en: Agentic Reinforcement Learning and Self-Evolving Agents. Reinforcement learning has become an effective mechanism for improving multimodal reasoning and decision-making, spanning visual perception ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , general multimodal reasoning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and video reasoning ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Agentic RL further couples policy optimization with multi-turn interaction and tool use, enabling models to learn adaptive behaviors in external environments ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Ding et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Tian et al., 2026 ) . Beyond single-policy optimization, recent self-evolving agents seek continual improvement from accumulated interaction experience: EvolveR ( Wu et al., 2025 ) distills reusable strategies from past trajectories, SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) recursively evolves a hierarchical skill library together with the agent policy, Agent0 ( Xia et al., 2025 ) constructs progressively challenging curricula through autonomous interaction, and Evolving-RL ( Fan et al., 2026 ) jointly optimizes experience extraction and utilization. Existing self-evolving agents mainly improve reasoning strategies, skills, and experience use. For long-video agents, however, what to remember and how to retrieve form an equally fundamental axis of evolution: what is preserved determines what can be retrieved, while retrieval utility in turn determines what is worth preserving.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习与自演化智能体。 强化学习已成为提升多模态推理与决策的有效机制，涵盖视觉感知（Liu 等，2025）、通用多模态推理（Wang 等，2026）和视频推理（Feng 等，2026）。 智能体强化学习进一步将策略优化与多轮交互及工具使用相结合，使模型能够在外部环境中学习自适应行为（Wang 等，2025e；Ding 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026b；Yang 等，2026a；Tian 等，2026）。 除了单策略优化之外，近期的自演化智能体致力于从累积的交互经验中实现持续改进：EvolveR（Wu 等，2025）从历史轨迹中提炼可重复使用的策略，SkillRL（Xia 等，2026）递归地演化分层技能库与智能体策略，Agent0（Xia 等，2025）通过自主交互构建逐步提升难度的课程，而 Evolving-RL（Fan 等，2026）则联合优化经验提取与利用。 现有的自演化智能体主要改进推理策略、技能和经验使用方式。 然而，对于长视频智能体而言，“记住什么”和“如何检索”构成了同样基础的演化维度：保留的内容决定了可检索的内容，而检索的效用反过来又决定了哪些内容值得保留。

paragraphs.en: VideoEvolve (Figure 2 ) comprises four tightly connected components: (1) the Memory Evolver (Sec. 3.2 ) learns what to remember through selective memory augmentation; (2) the Retrieval Evolver (Sec. 3.3 ) learns how to retrieve from the evolving memory; (3) Alternating Agentic RL (Sec. 3.4 ) co-evolves memory construction and retrieval through alternating optimization; and (4) Bottleneck-Aware Evolution Feedback (BEF) and Capability-Aware Evolution Feedback (CEF) (Sec. 3.5 ) diagnose the current bottleneck and capability frontier to guide the next cycle.
paragraphs.zh: VideoEvolve（图2）由四个紧密相连的组件构成：（1）记忆演化器（第3.2节）通过选择性记忆增强来学习需要记忆的内容；（2）检索演化器（第3.3节）学习如何从不断演化的记忆中检索信息；（3）交替智能体强化学习（第3.4节）通过交替优化，协同演化记忆构建与检索过程；以及（4）瓶颈感知演化反馈（BEF）和能力感知演化反馈（CEF）（第3.5节），用于诊断当前的瓶颈和能力边界，以指导下一轮演化。

paragraphs.en: The Memory Evolver (Figure 2 (a)) learns what information should be preserved through an Observe–Decide–Augment process. We first construct a fixed hierarchical Base Memory B B from a coarse low-frame-rate overview, organized into Root–Super–Macro nodes to provide broad temporal coverage and multi-granular retrieval anchors. The Base Memory remains fixed throughout evolution, while its complementary information acquisition is learned. Memory construction is question-agnostic, such that the Memory Evolver does not observe downstream questions or answers. The hierarchy, record schema, and retrieval organization are detailed in Appendix A.1.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 记忆演化器（图 2 (a)）通过“观察–决策–增强”过程学习哪些信息应当被保留。 我们首先基于粗略的低帧率概览构建一个固定的分层基础记忆 B B，并将其组织为根节点–超级节点–宏观节点，以实现广泛的时间覆盖和多粒度检索锚点。 在整个演化过程中，基础记忆保持固定，而其互补的信息获取方式则通过学习获得。 记忆的构建与问题无关，因此记忆演化器不会观察下游的问题或答案。 分层结构、记录方案及检索组织方式详见附录 A.1.1。

paragraphs.en: Alternating Co-Evolution. At cycle k k , we first freeze the Retrieval Evolver R k R^{k} and Optimize Memory . paragraphs.en: Alternating Agentic RL defines how the Memory and Retrieval Evolvers are optimized, but their relative training needs can shift across cycles. Two complementary feedback mechanisms therefore determine how much each Evolver should evolve and where next-cycle optimization should focus.
paragraphs.zh: 交替智能体强化学习定义了记忆和检索演化器如何被优化，但它们的相对训练需求在不同周期中可能会发生变化。 因此，两种互补的反馈机制决定了每个演化器应演化的程度以及下一周期的优化应聚焦于何处。

sents.en: Alternating Agentic RL defines how the Memory and Retrieval Evolvers are optimized, but their relative training needs can shift across cycles.

paragraphs.en: Training. Two-stage SFT initializes the Retrieval Evolver R 0 R^{0} with context-conditioned next-action supervision: Stage I teaches multi-turn tool use through high-quality long-video trajectories; Stage II continues on a larger, more diverse visual-trajectory set to broaden evidence seeking. The Memory Evolver skips cold-start SFT. Each Agentic RL cycle updates the Memory Evolver with retrieval frozen, rebuilds memory using its updated policy, then trains retrieval on fixed memory. BEF and CEF set next-cycle evolution shares and capability focus; Base Memory construction, the Writer, and retrieval tools remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 训练。 两阶段 SFT 通过上下文条件化的下一步动作监督来初始化检索演化器 R 0 R^{0}：第一阶段通过高质量长视频轨迹教授多轮工具使用；第二阶段则在更大、更多样的视觉轨迹数据集上继续训练，以拓展证据搜寻能力。 记忆演化器跳过冷启动阶段的 SFT。 每个智能体强化学习周期都会将检索功能冻结，使用更新后的策略重建记忆，然后在固定记忆上训练检索功能。 BEF 和 CEF 设定下一周期的演化份额与能力重点；基础记忆构建、写入器和检索工具保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: Datasets and Evaluation Metrics. For the Retrieval Evolver’s two-stage cold-start SFT, Stages I and II use 4,317 LongVT-derived ( Yang et al., 2026a ) tool-use trajectories and 102,732 trajectories on LLaVA videos ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , respectively. Both sets are generated by Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) . After excluding audio-dependent samples, we use 514 videos (2,056 questions) from Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) for Agentic RL. A disjoint set of 128 videos (512 questions) supports BEF/CEF diagnosis and scheduling without gradient updates. We report multiple-choice accuracy on Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and MMVU ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Baseline categorization and source-specific evaluation settings are detailed in Appendix A.8 .

For the training-based variant, the Memory Evolver, Retrieval Evolver, and frozen Writer use Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , respectively. paragraphs.en: Comparison with Video-MLLMs. VideoEvolve establishes a clear advantage over existing open-source Video-MLLMs, ranking first among the listed open-source methods on all six metrics across five benchmarks (Table 1 ). The gains are especially pronounced on LongVideoBench and LVBench: VideoEvolve achieves 70.2% and 58.9% , surpassing the strongest listed open-source baselines, ParaVT and VideoZoomer, by 9.8 and 17.4 percentage points, respectively. Notably, these large margins are achieved over strong agentic baselines. VideoEvolve further outperforms our tool-enabled Qwen3-VL-8B baseline by 14.7–28.6 points, marking a substantial advance over the off-the-shelf tool-enabled configuration. Together with the single-Evolver ablations in Table 3 , these results highlight the strength of our core design: co-evolving what is remembered and how it is retrieved, rather than optimizing either side in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Video-MLLMs 的对比。 VideoEvolve 在现有开源 Video-MLLMs 中展现出明显优势，在五个基准测试的全部六个指标中均位列所列开源方法之首（表 1）。 这些提升在 LongVideoBench 和 LVBench 上尤为显著：VideoEvolve 分别取得了 70.2% 和 58.9% 的成绩，比最强的开源基线模型 ParaVT 和 VideoZoomer 高出 9.8 和 17.4 个百分点。 值得注意的是，这些较大的优势是相对于强大的智能体基线模型取得的。 VideoEvolve 还比我们启用工具的 Qwen3-VL-8B 基线模型高出 14.7–28.6 分，标志着相较于现成的工具启用配置实现了重大进步。 结合表 3 中的单 Evolver 消融实验结果，这些成果凸显了我们核心设计的优势：协同进化记忆内容与检索方式，而非单独优化其中任何一方。

sents.en: VideoEvolve establishes a clear advantage over existing open-source Video-MLLMs, ranking first among the listed open-source methods on all six metrics across five benchmarks (Table 1 ).
sents.zh: VideoEvolve 在现有开源 Video-MLLMs 中展现出明显优势，在五个基准测试的全部六个指标中均位列所列开源方法之首（表 1）。

sents.en: The gains are especially pronounced on LongVideoBench and LVBench: VideoEvolve achieves 70.2% and 58.9% , surpassing the strongest listed open-source baselines, ParaVT and VideoZoomer, by 9.8 and 17.4 percentage points, respectively.
sents.zh: 这些提升在 LongVideoBench 和 LVBench 上尤为显著：VideoEvolve 分别取得了 70.2% 和 58.9% 的成绩，比最强的开源基线模型 ParaVT 和 VideoZoomer 高出 9.8 和 17.4 个百分点。

sents.en: Notably, these large margins are achieved over strong agentic baselines.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，这些较大的优势是相对于强大的智能体基线模型取得的。

sents.en: VideoEvolve further outperforms our tool-enabled Qwen3-VL-8B baseline by 14.7–28.6 points, marking a substantial advance over the off-the-shelf tool-enabled configuration.
sents.zh: VideoEvolve 还比我们启用工具的 Qwen3-VL-8B 基线模型高出 14.7–28.6 分，标志着相较于现成的工具启用配置实现了重大进步。

sents.en: Together with the single-Evolver ablations in Table 3 , these results highlight the strength of our core design: co-evolving what is remembered and how it is retrieved, rather than optimizing either side in isolation.
sents.zh: 结合表 3 中的单 Evolver 消融实验结果，这些成果凸显了我们核心设计的优势：协同进化记忆内容与检索方式，而非单独优化其中任何一方。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with Memory-Based Methods. VideoEvolve also leads both groups of dedicated memory-based systems in Table 2 . With an 8B Retrieval Evolver, the trained variant achieves 58.9% on LVBench and 67.1% on Video-MME (Long), outperforming the listed training-based baselines. Its 14.5 -point margin over MemVid, the strongest LVBench baseline in this group, is particularly substantial, extending the advantage of our co-evolving system to methods that already learn memory or retrieval components. The training-free Qwen3.8-27B configuration likewise leads its group, reaching 76.7% and 78.8% and surpassing MERIT-GPT by 4.9 and 1.1 percentage points, respectively. This complementary result highlights the strength of our memory–retrieval design even without task-specific parameter updates. Source-specific protocols and configuration differences are detailed in Appendix A.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 与基于记忆的方法的比较。 VideoEvolve 在表 2 中也优于两组专门的基于记忆的系统。 使用 8B Retrieval Evolver，训练后的变体在 LVBench 上达到 58.9%，在 Video-MME (Long) 上达到 67.1%，超越了所列的训练基线方法。 它在 LVBench 上比该组最强的基线方法 MemVid 高出 14.5 个百分点，这一差距尤为显著，表明我们的协同演化系统在那些已经学习记忆或检索组件的方法中仍具有优势。 无需训练的 Qwen3.8-27B 配置同样在其组别中领先，分别达到 76.7% 和 78.8%，比 MERIT-GPT 高出 4.9 和 1.1 个百分点。 这一补充性结果凸显了我们的记忆–检索设计的优势，即使没有针对特定任务的参数更新也是如此。 与源数据相关的协议和配置差异详见附录 A.8。

paragraphs.en: Co-evolution. Joint evolution provides gains beyond single-sided optimization (Table 3 (a,b)). With BEF and CEF disabled in all three variants, co-evolution outperforms either single-Evolver variant on six of seven metrics, reaching 56.6% on LVBench versus 51.1% for memory-only and 52.7% for retrieval-only evolution. MMVU is the exception, addressed by feedback guidance below. Removing alternating updates from the full system also lowers LongVideoBench (Long) accuracy by 4.0 points. These comparisons support learning both policies through alternating updates, rather than improving either side in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 协同进化。 联合进化带来的收益超越了单侧优化（表3 (a,b)）。 在所有三种变体中禁用 BEF 和 CEF 后，协同进化在七项指标中的六项上优于任一单 Evolver 变体：在 LVBench 上的准确率达到 56.6%，而仅通过记忆进化的准确率为 51.1%，仅通过检索进化的准确率为 52.7%。 MMVU 是例外情况，下文将通过反馈指导加以解决。 从完整系统中移除交替更新也会使 LongVideoBench (Long) 的准确率下降 4.0 个百分点。 这些比较支持通过交替更新来学习两种策略，而非孤立地改进其中某一方。

paragraphs.en: Evolution guidance. BEF and CEF close this gap and further strengthen co-evolution (Table 3 (b)). Their combination raises MMVU accuracy from 68.4% to 75.1%, exceeding both BEF alone (73.2%) and CEF alone (70.3%). This highlights the value of coordinating bottleneck-aware allocation with capability-aware sampling. Disabling frontier diagnosis also reduces MMVU accuracy by 2.2 points, supporting the selection of informative training instances within each capability.
paragraphs.zh: 演化引导。 BEF 和 CEF 填补了这一差距，并进一步增强了协同演化（表 3 (b)）。 二者的结合将 MMVU 准确率从 68.4% 提升至 75.1%，超过了单独使用 BEF（73.2%）和单独使用 CEF（70.3%）的效果。 这凸显了将瓶颈感知分配与能力感知采样相结合的重要性。 禁用前沿诊断也会使 MMVU 准确率下降 2.2 个百分点，从而支持在每个能力层级内选择具有信息价值的训练实例。

paragraphs.en: Video revisiting. Without raw-video revisiting, VideoEvolve still achieves 65.5% on Video-MME (Long) and 57.5% on LVBench (Table 3 (c)). Revisiting adds 0.8–1.6 points on all seven metrics, complementing strong memory-based reasoning with selective access to additional visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 视频重访。 在没有原始视频重访的情况下，VideoEvolve 在 Video-MME (Long) 上仍能达到 65.5% 的成绩，在 LVBench 上达到 57.5%（表 3(c)）。 重访在所有七项指标上分别增加了 0.8–1.6 分，将强大的基于记忆推理与对额外视觉证据的选择性访问相结合。

paragraphs.en: Co-evolution delivers substantial gains even without raw-video access (Table 4 ). By Cycle 3, Memory-only accuracy rises from 45.6% to 57.5%, surpassing the initial Revisit-enabled result by 7.2 points. Revisit-enabled accuracy peaks at 58.9%, while the gap narrows from 4.7 to 1.4 points. Cycle 4 further improves Memory-only accuracy but lowers Revisit-enabled accuracy to 58.6%. Together, these results validate the central premise of VideoEvolve: effective long video reasoning benefits from jointly learning what to preserve and how to use it.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present VideoEvolve, a self-evolving framework that closes the learning loop between memory construction and retrieval for long video understanding. Through alternating Agentic RL, reasoning feedback guides what memory preserves, while the updated memory shapes how retrieval learns to access evidence. BEF and CEF steer this loop toward current bottlenecks and underdeveloped yet learnable capabilities. Across five benchmarks, VideoEvolve outperforms the evaluated open-source Video-MLLM baselines, and its trained and training-free variants lead their respective memory-based comparisons. Ablations and cycle-wise analysis further support this feedback-guided co-evolution. More broadly, VideoEvolve reframes memory from a fixed record of video content into a learnable interface between perception and reasoning, with its construction and use refined together through task experience.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 VideoEvolve——一个自我演化的框架，它实现了长期视频理解中记忆构建与检索之间的学习闭环。 通过交替执行智能体强化学习（Agentic RL），推理反馈会指导哪些内容应被保留在记忆中，而更新后的记忆则会决定检索如何学习获取证据。 BEF 和 CEF 会将这一循环引导至当前的瓶颈以及尚未充分发展但仍有学习潜力的能力上。 在五个基准测试中，VideoEvolve 的表现优于所评估的开源 Video-MLLM 基线模型，其训练版和无训练版变体均在各自基于记忆的比较中处于领先地位。 消融实验和逐周期分析进一步验证了这种由反馈引导的协同演化机制的有效性。 更广泛地说，VideoEvolve 将记忆从对视频内容的静态记录重新定义为感知与推理之间的一个可学习的接口，其构建与使用过程通过任务经验共同优化。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides implementation details, supplementary experimental results, and a discussion of limitations for VideoEvolve. Sections A.1 and A.2 describe memory construction and versioning, and the retrieval tools and interaction protocol, respectively. Section A.3 presents data processing and two-stage cold-start training. Sections A.4 and A.5 detail alternating updates and quality-first optimization, followed by BEF scheduling and CEF’s capability definitions, diagnosis, and targeted training procedure. Section A.6 summarizes training hyperparameters and runtime budgets, while Section A.7 provides condensed prompt templates. Section A.8 clarifies evaluation settings and memory-based comparison protocols, and Section A.9 reports extended ablation results. Finally, Section A.10 discusses limitations and future work.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了 VideoEvolve 的实现细节、补充实验结果以及对局限性的讨论。 A.1 和 A.2 节分别描述了内存构建与版本管理，以及检索工具和交互协议。 A.3 节介绍了数据处理和两阶段冷启动训练方法。 A.4 和 A.5 节详细阐述了交替更新与质量优先优化策略，随后介绍了 BEF 调度机制、CEF 的能力定义、诊断流程及针对性训练方案。 A.6 节总结了训练超参数和运行时预算，而 A.7 节提供了精简的提示模板。 A.8 节阐明了评估设置与基于内存的比较协议，A.9 节则报告了扩展的消融实验结果。 最后，A.10 节讨论了研究的局限性与未来工作方向。

paragraphs.en: We uniformly sample the video at 0.5 fps and divide it into Macro intervals of at most 30 seconds, with the final interval clipped to the video duration. The frozen Writer processes the sampled visual evidence and available subtitles to produce local events, entities, OCR records, and summaries. A Base extraction request accepts at most 24 frames, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels. Six-second CaptionUnits provide temporal anchors for subtitles and saved keyframes; they do not imply an additional visual-captioning call every six seconds. Macro-level extraction is consolidated before higher-level Super summaries are constructed, and the Root provides navigation over the hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 0.5 fps 的帧率对视频进行均匀采样，并将其划分为最长不超过 30 秒的宏观区间，最后一个区间则根据视频时长进行裁剪。 冻结的“Writer”会处理采样得到的视觉证据和可用字幕，以生成局部事件、实体、OCR 记录及摘要。 一次基础提取请求最多可接受 24 帧图像，且这些图像的最大长边尺寸会被调整至 896 像素。 六秒长的“CaptionUnit”为字幕和保存的关键帧提供时间锚点；但这并不意味着每六秒都会额外调用一次视觉字幕生成接口。 在构建更高级别的“Super”摘要之前，会先整合宏观级别的提取结果，而“Root”则用于在该层级结构中实现导航。

sents.en: We uniformly sample the video at 0.5 fps and divide it into Macro intervals of at most 30 seconds, with the final interval clipped to the video duration.
sents.zh: 我们以 0.5 fps 的帧率对视频进行均匀采样，并将其划分为最长不超过 30 秒的宏观区间，最后一个区间则根据视频时长进行裁剪。

sents.en: The frozen Writer processes the sampled visual evidence and available subtitles to produce local events, entities, OCR records, and summaries.
sents.zh: 冻结的“Writer”会处理采样得到的视觉证据和可用字幕，以生成局部事件、实体、OCR 记录及摘要。

sents.en: A Base extraction request accepts at most 24 frames, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels.
sents.zh: 一次基础提取请求最多可接受 24 帧图像，且这些图像的最大长边尺寸会被调整至 896 像素。

sents.en: Six-second CaptionUnits provide temporal anchors for subtitles and saved keyframes; they do not imply an additional visual-captioning call every six seconds.
sents.zh: 六秒长的“CaptionUnit”为字幕和保存的关键帧提供时间锚点；但这并不意味着每六秒都会额外调用一次视觉字幕生成接口。

sents.en: Macro-level extraction is consolidated before higher-level Super summaries are constructed, and the Root provides navigation over the hierarchy.
sents.zh: 在构建更高级别的“Super”摘要之前，会先整合宏观级别的提取结果，而“Root”则用于在该层级结构中实现导航。

paragraphs.en: The Base is constructed once per video and is not rewritten during co-evolution. A policy version produces its own Delta from this same Base, and the published memory is the union of the Base and that version’s accepted records. Historical Deltas are not recursively accumulated. All questions associated with a video share this memory, while question text, answer options, ground-truth answers, and capability labels are excluded from the construction policy’s input. Entity records support local retrieval but do not constitute a guarantee of consistent identity tracking across the entire video.
paragraphs.zh: 基座在每个视频中仅构建一次，在协同进化过程中不会被重新编写。 一个策略版本会基于这个相同的基座生成其自身的增量，而已发布的记忆则是基座与该版本所接受记录的并集。 历史增量不会以递归方式累积。 与某个视频相关的所有问题都共享这份记忆，但问题文本、答案选项、标准答案和能力标签不会被纳入构建策略的输入中。 实体记录支持局部检索，但并不保证在整个视频中能够始终如一地追踪同一实体的身份。

sents.en: The Base is constructed once per video and is not rewritten during co-evolution.
sents.zh: 基座在每个视频中仅构建一次，在协同进化过程中不会被重新编写。

sents.en: A policy version produces its own Delta from this same Base, and the published memory is the union of the Base and that version’s accepted records.
sents.zh: 一个策略版本会基于这个相同的基座生成其自身的增量，而已发布的记忆则是基座与该版本所接受记录的并集。

sents.en: Historical Deltas are not recursively accumulated.
sents.zh: 历史增量不会以递归方式累积。

sents.zh: 与某个视频相关的所有问题都共享这份记忆，但问题文本、答案选项、标准答案和能力标签不会被纳入构建策略的输入中。

sents.en: Entity records support local retrieval but do not constitute a guarantee of consistent identity tracking across the entire video.
sents.zh: 实体记录支持局部检索，但并不保证在整个视频中能够始终如一地追踪同一实体的身份。

paragraphs.en: The Base separates a coarse-to-fine navigation hierarchy from its local evidence records and temporal index. Its three navigation levels are Root → \rightarrow Super → \rightarrow Macro : one video-wide Root, a set of higher-level Super groups, and the Macro intervals that cover the video. Their roles and stored content are as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 该基础结构将一种从粗略到精细的导航层级与其局部证据记录和时间索引分离开来。 其三个导航层级为：根节点 → \rightarrow 超级节点 → \rightarrow 宏观节点，即一个覆盖整个视频的根节点、一组更高级别的超级节点组，以及覆盖整个视频的宏观区间。 它们的作用和存储内容如下所示。

sents.en: The Base separates a coarse-to-fine navigation hierarchy from its local evidence records and temporal index.
sents.zh: 该基础结构将一种从粗略到精细的导航层级与其局部证据记录和时间索引分离开来。

sents.en: Its three navigation levels are Root → \rightarrow Super → \rightarrow Macro : one video-wide Root, a set of higher-level Super groups, and the Macro intervals that cover the video.
sents.zh: 其三个导航层级为：根节点 → \rightarrow 超级节点 → \rightarrow 宏观节点，即一个覆盖整个视频的根节点、一组更高级别的超级节点组，以及覆盖整个视频的宏观区间。

sents.en: Their roles and stored content are as follows.
sents.zh: 它们的作用和存储内容如下所示。

paragraphs.en: Root: video-level overview. The Root stores the full-video time range, duration, counts of Super and Macro nodes, a short description, and frequently mentioned entity names. Its description is formed deterministically by concatenating Super descriptions and retaining the first 500 characters; up to 20 entity names are selected by their frequency in Macro-level name lists. It provides an entry point into the video, not an exhaustive summary, and requires no additional Writer call.
paragraphs.zh: Root：视频级概览。 Root 存储完整视频的时间范围、时长、Super 和 Macro 节点的数量、简短描述以及频繁提及的实体名称。 其描述通过确定性地拼接 Super 描述并保留前 500 个字符形成；最多选择 20 个实体名称，依据其在 Macro 级名称列表中的频率确定。 它提供了进入视频的入口，而非详尽的摘要，且无需额外的 Writer 调用。

sents.en: Root: video-level overview.
sents.zh: Root：视频级概览。

sents.en: The Root stores the full-video time range, duration, counts of Super and Macro nodes, a short description, and frequently mentioned entity names.
sents.zh: Root 存储完整视频的时间范围、时长、Super 和 Macro 节点的数量、简短描述以及频繁提及的实体名称。

sents.en: Its description is formed deterministically by concatenating Super descriptions and retaining the first 500 characters; up to 20 entity names are selected by their frequency in Macro-level name lists.
sents.zh: 其描述通过确定性地拼接 Super 描述并保留前 500 个字符形成；最多选择 20 个实体名称，依据其在 Macro 级名称列表中的频率确定。

sents.en: It provides an entry point into the video, not an exhaustive summary, and requires no additional Writer call.
sents.zh: 它提供了进入视频的入口，而非详尽的摘要，且无需额外的 Writer 调用。

paragraphs.en: Super: higher-level grouping. Each Super stores a label, a narrative description, key entity names, member Macro IDs, and aggregated temporal anchors. After Macro extraction, the frozen Writer is prompted to group temporally adjacent and semantically related Macros. Invalid or repeated Macro assignments are removed, and omitted Macros are assigned through deterministic fallback grouping. A Super spans the earliest start and latest end of its members; unlike a Macro, it has no fixed duration.
paragraphs.zh: Super：更高层级的分组。 每个 Super 存储一个标签、一段叙述性描述、关键实体名称、成员 Macro ID 以及聚合后的时间锚点。 Macro 提取完成后，系统会提示已冻结的 Writer 将时间上相邻且语义相关的 Macro 进行分组。 无效或重复的 Macro 分配将被移除，而被省略的 Macro 则通过确定性回退分组进行分配。 一个 Super 覆盖其成员的最早开始时间和最晚结束时间；与 Macro 不同，它没有固定的持续时间。

sents.en: Super: higher-level grouping.
sents.zh: Super：更高层级的分组。

sents.en: Each Super stores a label, a narrative description, key entity names, member Macro IDs, and aggregated temporal anchors.
sents.zh: 每个 Super 存储一个标签、一段叙述性描述、关键实体名称、成员 Macro ID 以及聚合后的时间锚点。

sents.en: After Macro extraction, the frozen Writer is prompted to group temporally adjacent and semantically related Macros.
sents.zh: Macro 提取完成后，系统会提示已冻结的 Writer 将时间上相邻且语义相关的 Macro 进行分组。

sents.en: Invalid or repeated Macro assignments are removed, and omitted Macros are assigned through deterministic fallback grouping.
sents.zh: 无效或重复的 Macro 分配将被移除，而被省略的 Macro 则通过确定性回退分组进行分配。

sents.en: A Super spans the earliest start and latest end of its members; unlike a Macro, it has no fixed duration.
sents.zh: 一个 Super 覆盖其成员的最早开始时间和最晚结束时间；与 Macro 不同，它没有固定的持续时间。

paragraphs.en: Macro: local evidence container. For a video of duration T T , Macro i i covers [ 30 ​ i , min ⁡ ( 30 ​ ( i + 1 ) , T ) ] [30i,\min(30(i+1),T)] seconds, for i = 0 , … , ⌈ T / 30 ⌉ − 1 i=0,\ldots,\lceil T/30\rceil-1 . Each Macro stores its ID, interval, label, summary, detailed narrative, entity descriptors, event and OCR summaries, state changes, and references to CaptionUnits and saved keyframes. The detailed local records are retained separately and remain accessible through their Macro membership. Thus, upper-level summaries do not replace the underlying records.
paragraphs.zh: 宏：本地证据容器。 对于时长为 T 的视频，Macro i 覆盖 [30i, min(30(i+1), T)] 秒，其中 i = 0, …, ⌈T/30⌉−1。 每个宏存储其 ID、时间区间、标签、摘要、详细叙述、实体描述符、事件和 OCR 摘要、状态变化，以及对 CaptionUnit 和已保存关键帧的引用。 详细的本地记录被单独保留，并可通过其所属的宏继续访问。 因此，上层摘要不会取代底层的原始记录。

sents.zh: 对于时长为 T 的视频，Macro i 覆盖 [30i, min(30(i+1), T)] 秒，其中 i = 0, …, ⌈T/30⌉−1。

sents.zh: 详细的本地记录被单独保留，并可通过其所属的宏继续访问。

sents.zh: 因此，上层摘要不会取代底层的原始记录。

paragraphs.en: Within a Macro, Event , Entity , and OCRText are typed evidence records, not additional navigation levels. An Event stores its ID, description, event type, absolute time interval, subject, object, action, and references to local participant Entity IDs. An Entity stores a local ID, name, type, attributes, and description; visual-grounding metadata is retained when available. An OCRText record stores its ID, recognized text, type, description, and time interval. State changes and timestamped narrative details are also preserved in Macro fields. Event and OCR records carry time-basis metadata; an Entity without a localized visual timestamp is indexed over its containing Macro interval, not treated as a continuously tracked identity.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Macro 中，Event、Entity 和 OCRText 是带类型标记的证据记录，而非额外的导航层级。 一个 Event 存储其 ID、描述、事件类型、绝对时间间隔、主体、客体、动作以及对本地参与者 Entity ID 的引用。 一个 Entity 存储本地 ID、名称、类型、属性和描述；若有可用数据，则会保留视觉定位元数据。 一个 OCRText 记录存储其 ID、识别出的文本、类型、描述和时间间隔。 状态变化和时间戳叙事细节也保存在 Macro 字段中。 Event 和 OCR 记录携带时间基准元数据；没有本地化视觉时间戳的 Entity 会依据其所在的 Macro 时间间隔进行索引，而非被视为持续追踪的身份标识。

sents.zh: 在 Macro 中，Event、Entity 和 OCRText 是带类型标记的证据记录，而非额外的导航层级。

paragraphs.en: Explicit SUBEVENT_OF links connect each Macro to its Super and each Super to the Root. Deterministic BEFORE chains connect successive Macro members within a Super and successive Super entries. The aggregation stage can additionally retain model-generated Super relations, such as causal or progression links; these are model inferences rather than independently verified facts. In contrast, the local Macro subgraph does not generate a separate semantic edge list: its compatibility edges field is empty. Participant references and relational descriptions reside in Event fields and text. The term “subgraph” therefore denotes the Macro’s structured local records, not a fully populated entity–relation knowledge graph.
paragraphs.zh: 显式的 SUBEVENT_OF 链接将每个 Macro 与其 Super 连接起来，并将每个 Super 与 Root 连接起来。 确定性的 BEFORE 链连接了 Super 内部连续的 Macro 成员以及连续的 Super 条目。 聚合阶段还可以保留模型生成的 Super 关系，例如因果或进展链接；这些是模型的推断，而非独立验证的事实。 相比之下，局部的 Macro 子图不会生成独立的语义边列表：其兼容性边字段为空。 参与者引用和关系描述位于 Event 字段和文本中。 因此，“子图”一词指的是 Macro 的结构化局部记录，而非一个完全填充的实体–关系知识图谱。

sents.zh: 显式的 SUBEVENT_OF 链接将每个 Macro 与其 Super 连接起来，并将每个 Super 与 Root 连接起来。

paragraphs.en: CaptionUnits form a separate six-second temporal grid, retaining IDs, start and end times, and keyframe IDs. Although the schema supports subtitle text, raw subtitles are not exposed to Retrieval in the evaluated configurations: subtitle information is available only through Writer-generated memory. A keyframe catalog maps each saved frame ID to its decoded timestamp and image path; here “keyframe” denotes a stored uniform sample, not a frame selected by a salience detector. Macro anchors connect these temporal units and images to the hierarchy. In the retrieval view, each CaptionUnit is assigned to one Macro by its temporal midpoint, avoiding duplicate ownership at interval boundaries. These units serve as temporal and image anchors, not raw-subtitle search documents. The associations complement the hierarchy rather than constituting another strict parent–child level.
paragraphs.zh: CaptionUnit 构成一个独立的六秒时间网格，保留其 ID、开始和结束时间以及关键帧 ID。 尽管该架构支持字幕文本，但在所评估的配置中，原始字幕并未向检索模块开放：字幕信息仅能通过 Writer 生成的记忆获取。 关键帧目录将每个已保存的帧 ID 映射到其解码后的时间戳和图像路径；此处“关键帧”指存储的均匀采样，而非由显著性检测器选中的帧。 宏观锚点将这些时间单位和图像连接到层级结构中。 在检索视图中，每个 CaptionUnit 会根据其时间中点被分配给一个 Macro，从而避免在时间区间边界处出现重复归属。 这些单位充当时间和图像锚点，而非原始字幕的搜索文档。 这些关联关系是对层级结构的补充，而非构成另一个严格的父子层级。

sents.zh: CaptionUnit 构成一个独立的六秒时间网格，保留其 ID、开始和结束时间以及关键帧 ID。

paragraphs.en: After bottom-up construction, a deterministic preprocessing step materializes compact Macro overviews, fine-grained documents, Macro-to-document membership lists, and the keyframe catalog. A local document uses the namespaced ID macro_id::local_id ; CaptionUnits use caption::caption_id . Documents retain their type, Macro and Super membership, time range, source reference, and original payload. Root and Super summaries provide initial navigation context and are not indexed as ordinary search documents; Macro overviews and nonempty local evidence provide coarse and fine textual search entries. Search text is separated from the stored record payload, so a concise hit does not discard the underlying details.
paragraphs.zh: 自底向上构建之后，一个确定性预处理步骤会生成紧凑的宏观概览、细粒度文档、宏观到文档的成员关系列表以及关键帧目录。 本地文档使用命名空间 ID macro_id::local_id；标题单元使用 caption::caption_id。 文档保留其类型、宏观和超级成员关系、时间范围、来源引用以及原始负载。 根和超级摘要提供初始导航上下文，且不作为普通搜索文档进行索引；宏观概览和非空的本地证据则提供粗略和精细的文本搜索条目。 搜索文本与存储记录中的负载分离，因此简洁的匹配结果不会丢弃其底层的详细信息。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates how the fixed Base becomes an augmented, reusable memory. The Base supplies initial evidence and navigation; the learned Controller selects additional observations, and the frozen Writer converts them into source-linked records.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 展示了固定的 Base 如何成为一个增强且可重用的记忆。 Base 提供初始证据和导航；经过学习的 Controller 选择额外的观察结果，而冻结的 Writer 则将其转换为与源数据关联的记录。

paragraphs.en: Here, “where” denotes a Macro and temporal region, “how much” a discrete frame level within that region, and “what” an extraction focus. These choices direct observation toward evidence such as actions, object attributes, and interactions. Records passing the acceptance rules form the Delta: full records remain searchable, while bounded digests expose their content at Macro and Super levels. Thus, “refine descriptions” in the figure means supplementing the retrieval view, not overwriting the original Base. The resulting Base-plus-Delta memory and its matching index are shared by questions about the same video.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，“where”表示一个宏观和时间区域，“how much”表示该区域内的离散帧级别，“what”则表示提取焦点。 这些选择将观察方向引导至诸如动作、物体属性和交互等证据上。 通过接受规则的记录构成 Delta：完整记录仍可供搜索，而有限摘要则会在宏观和超宏观层级暴露其内容。 因此，图中“精炼描述”意味着补充检索视图，而非覆盖原始 Base。 由此产生的 Base-plus-Delta 记忆及其匹配的索引会被关于同一视频的问题所共享。

paragraphs.en: Within one construction trajectory, the Controller accumulates evidence under fixed budgets without updating its parameters. Across training cycles, the frozen Retrieval policy evaluates candidate memories on downstream questions, and quality-first RL updates the Controller’s observation decisions (Appendix A.4 ). The updated Controller then reconstructs each training video’s memory from the same Base, producing a new Delta and index rather than appending historical Deltas. Evolution therefore concerns the learned construction policy and the memories it produces; gradients do not pass through memory records or the frozen Writer. At inference, the learned policy constructs a question-agnostic memory without online policy optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 在单个构建轨迹中，控制器在固定预算下积累证据，但不更新其参数。 在整个训练周期中，冻结的检索策略对下游问题评估候选记忆，而质量优先强化学习则更新控制器的观察决策（附录 A.4）。 随后，更新后的控制器从相同的基模型中重构每个训练视频的记忆，生成新的差异和索引，而不是追加历史差异。 因此，演化涉及所学习的构建策略及其生成的记忆；梯度不会通过记忆记录或冻结的写入器传递。 在推理阶段，所学策略会构建一个与问题无关的记忆，而无需在线策略优化。

paragraphs.en: The first Controller decision selects an actionable Macro or STOP . Its context contains Base summaries, bounded Delta digests, observation history, and remaining budgets. The second decision receives details only for the selected Macro and chooses a region, a frame level, and an extraction focus. The regions are full , head , middle , tail , and boundary . The three interior regions divide the Macro into thirds; the boundary region spans 20 seconds around its end, clipped to the video, and is absent for the final Macro. Either stage may stop the entire construction trajectory; stopping at the second stage does not return to Macro selection.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个控制器的决策会选择一个可执行的宏或“停止”。 其上下文包含基础摘要、有界的增量摘要、观察历史以及剩余预算。 第二个决策仅接收所选宏的相关详细信息，并选择一个区域、一个帧级别和一个提取焦点。 这些区域包括完整区域、头部区域、中部区域、尾部区域和边界区域。 三个内部区域将宏划分为三等份；边界区域覆盖其结束前后20秒的时间段，并裁剪至视频范围内，最后一个宏则不包含该区域。 任一阶段都可能终止整个构建轨迹；在第二阶段停止后不会返回到宏选择环节。

paragraphs.en: Frame levels are { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\} . The focus is one or two of action_state , appearance_spatial , and text_alignment , or general alone, giving seven combinations. Each region permits at most two observations, and the exact tuple of Macro, region, frame level, and canonicalized focus cannot repeat. An observation consumes a visit even if the Writer returns no new record. Frame targets are nested across levels, mapped to actual source-frame timestamps within the requested window, and deduplicated within a request. Consequently, the number of decoded frames can be smaller than the selected level.
paragraphs.zh: 帧层级为 { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\}。 焦点可以是 action_state、appearance_spatial 和 text_alignment 中的一到两项，也可以是 general 单独使用，共形成七种组合。 每个区域最多允许两次观察，且 Macro、区域、帧层级和规范化焦点组成的确切元组不得重复。 即使 Writer 未返回任何新记录，一次观察也会消耗一次访问。 帧目标在不同层级间嵌套，映射到请求窗口内的实际源帧时间戳，并在单个请求内进行去重。 因此，解码后的帧数可能少于所选的层级。

paragraphs.en: The accepted supplemental description budget is b T = 4,096 b_{T}=4{,}096 tokens per video, with at most 256 tokens per step. Multiple focuses share one observation and text allowance. Frame accounting uses images actually delivered to the Writer, including additional deliveries for format repair. Transport retries are logged separately as service costs and do not create new policy actions. Base construction, supplemental observation, and question-time raw-video revisiting have separate budgets; none of these frame counts is a complete measure of end-to-end compute.

paragraphs.en: Each proposed record contains a description, an absolute time interval, referenced frame and subtitle IDs, and a relation flag indicating additional or conflicting information. The executor checks field types, finite and legal timestamps, source-ID existence, correspondence to the supplied observation, and text length. Records must cite supplied evidence. After these structural checks, descriptions are deduplicated by lowercasing and collapsing whitespace. Records explicitly marked as conflicts by the Writer are isolated rather than used to overwrite the Base. There is no additional learned verifier or semantic audit: valid provenance and formatting do not establish that every claim is true or that all semantic conflicts have been detected.
paragraphs.zh: 每条提议的记录都包含一个描述、一个绝对时间区间、引用的帧和字幕 ID，以及一个表示附加或冲突信息的关联标志。 执行者会检查字段类型、有限且合法的 timestamps、源 ID 是否存在、是否与提供的观察结果对应，以及文本长度。 记录必须引用所提供的证据。 在这些结构检查之后，描述会通过转换为小写和合并空白字符进行去重。 由“写入者”明确标记为冲突的记录会被隔离，而不是用来覆盖“基础”记录。 没有额外的学习验证器或语义审核：有效的来源和格式并不能证明每个主张都是真实的，也不能保证所有语义冲突都已被检测出来。

paragraphs.en: Accepted records remain individually searchable as fine-grained Events. Deterministic, length-bounded digests expose these records at their associated Macro and Super nodes, with evidence IDs retained and the original Base summaries stored separately. The complete records remain available through retrieval. Each published Base-plus-Delta view is paired with its own index; a Base index must not be reused as though it indexed an Enhanced memory.

sents.en: Each published Base-plus-Delta view is paired with its own index; a Base index must not be reused as though it indexed an Enhanced memory.
sents.zh: 每个已发布的“基线+增量”视图都与其自身的索引配对；基线索引不得被重复使用，仿佛它索引了一个增强内存。

paragraphs.en: Memory-only inference allows access to textual memory records and stored keyframes, but no newly acquired source-video frames. Revisit-enabled inference additionally exposes view_video ; enabling it does not force a revisit. We allow 64 raw-video frames per question in total and at most 16 per call, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels. Stored-frame inspection does not consume this raw-video allowance, although it consumes a tool call and contributes multimodal input to the policy.
paragraphs.zh: 仅内存推理可以访问文本记忆记录和存储的关键帧，但无法访问新获取的源视频帧。 启用重访的推理还会暴露 view_video；启用它并不会强制进行重访。 我们允许每个问题总共使用 64 个原始视频帧，每次调用最多使用 16 个，并将它们调整到最长边不超过 896 像素的大小。 存储帧的查看不会占用原始视频帧的配额，但会消耗一次工具调用，并为策略提供多模态输入。

sents.en: Memory-only inference allows access to textual memory records and stored keyframes, but no newly acquired source-video frames.
sents.zh: 仅内存推理可以访问文本记忆记录和存储的关键帧，但无法访问新获取的源视频帧。

sents.en: Revisit-enabled inference additionally exposes view_video ; enabling it does not force a revisit.
sents.zh: 启用重访的推理还会暴露 view_video；启用它并不会强制进行重访。

sents.en: We allow 64 raw-video frames per question in total and at most 16 per call, resized to a maximum long edge of 896 pixels.
sents.zh: 我们允许每个问题总共使用 64 个原始视频帧，每次调用最多使用 16 个，并将它们调整到最长边不超过 896 像素的大小。

sents.en: Stored-frame inspection does not consume this raw-video allowance, although it consumes a tool call and contributes multimodal input to the policy.
sents.zh: 存储帧的查看不会占用原始视频帧的配额，但会消耗一次工具调用，并为策略提供多模态输入。

paragraphs.en: Node search combines lexical BM25 and normalized dense-vector cosine similarity through weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. The embedding service uses Qwen3-Embedding-8B with 4,096-dimensional vectors and is held fixed during policy learning. Search hits and Root/Super summaries are navigation cues, not proof that every query condition is satisfied. The policy can inspect full records, page through truncated documents, and check stored images. Stored-frame requests with equal start and end times target that exact timestamp and may return no image; the executor does not silently substitute a nearby frame outside the requested interval.
paragraphs.zh: 节点搜索通过加权倒数排名融合，将词汇 BM25 与归一化密集向量余弦相似度相结合。 嵌入服务使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B，其向量为 4,096 维，并在策略学习过程中保持固定不变。 搜索结果以及根/父级摘要属于导航提示，而非证明每个查询条件均已满足的依据。 策略可以检查完整记录、逐页浏览截断文档，并查看已存储的图像。 起始时间与结束时间相等的已存储帧请求会精确指向该时间戳，且可能返回无图像；执行器不会静默替换请求区间之外的邻近帧。

sents.en: Node search combines lexical BM25 and normalized dense-vector cosine similarity through weighted reciprocal-rank fusion.
sents.zh: 节点搜索通过加权倒数排名融合，将词汇 BM25 与归一化密集向量余弦相似度相结合。

sents.en: The embedding service uses Qwen3-Embedding-8B with 4,096-dimensional vectors and is held fixed during policy learning.
sents.zh: 嵌入服务使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B，其向量为 4,096 维，并在策略学习过程中保持固定不变。

sents.en: Search hits and Root/Super summaries are navigation cues, not proof that every query condition is satisfied.
sents.zh: 搜索结果以及根/父级摘要属于导航提示，而非证明每个查询条件均已满足的依据。

sents.en: The policy can inspect full records, page through truncated documents, and check stored images.
sents.zh: 策略可以检查完整记录、逐页浏览截断文档，并查看已存储的图像。

sents.en: Stored-frame requests with equal start and end times target that exact timestamp and may return no image; the executor does not silently substitute a nearby frame outside the requested interval.
sents.zh: 起始时间与结束时间相等的已存储帧请求会精确指向该时间戳，且可能返回无图像；执行器不会静默替换请求区间之外的邻近帧。

paragraphs.en: Each interaction has 12 exploration slots, followed, if needed, by one final-only decision. During exploration, the policy may call a tool or answer; it may answer immediately when the initial evidence suffices. Abstention is available only in the final-only decision, which allows no further tool calls. Invalid intermediate actions execute no tool but consume a slot and return explicit validation feedback. The same policy performs evidence acquisition, reasoning, and answering; no separate answerer or verifier is invoked. Final citations must refer to observed ev_* records, although citation validity alone does not establish semantic support.
paragraphs.zh: 每次交互包含 12 个探索槽位，之后如有需要，可执行一次仅用于最终决策的操作。 在探索阶段，策略可以调用工具或给出答案；当初始证据足够时，它可以立即给出答案。 仅在最终决策中允许弃权，且该决策阶段不允许进一步调用工具。 无效的中间操作不会执行任何工具，但会消耗一个槽位并返回明确的验证反馈。 同一策略负责证据获取、推理和回答；不会调用独立的回答器或验证器。 最终引用的内容必须指向已观察到的 ev_* 记录，但引用本身的有效性并不足以确立语义支持。

sents.en: Each interaction has 12 exploration slots, followed, if needed, by one final-only decision.
sents.zh: 每次交互包含 12 个探索槽位，之后如有需要，可执行一次仅用于最终决策的操作。

sents.en: During exploration, the policy may call a tool or answer; it may answer immediately when the initial evidence suffices.
sents.zh: 在探索阶段，策略可以调用工具或给出答案；当初始证据足够时，它可以立即给出答案。

sents.zh: 仅在最终决策中允许弃权，且该决策阶段不允许进一步调用工具。

sents.en: Invalid intermediate actions execute no tool but consume a slot and return explicit validation feedback.
sents.zh: 无效的中间操作不会执行任何工具，但会消耗一个槽位并返回明确的验证反馈。

sents.en: The same policy performs evidence acquisition, reasoning, and answering; no separate answerer or verifier is invoked.
sents.zh: 同一策略负责证据获取、推理和回答；不会调用独立的回答器或验证器。

sents.en: Final citations must refer to observed ev_* records, although citation validity alone does not establish semantic support.
sents.zh: 最终引用的内容必须指向已观察到的 ev_* 记录，但引用本身的有效性并不足以确立语义支持。

paragraphs.en: Controller decisions use an enumeration of complete legal JSON actions, including STOP , so joint constraints on region, frames, and focus cannot be bypassed by combining individually valid fields. Retrieval uses the decision-specific JSON schema, available tools, and observed evidence IDs. RL rollouts retain the actual input and constraint state for each decision. Old-policy, updated-policy, and reference log probabilities are computed with the same legal-token masks and sampling temperature. Tool outputs, images, and earlier observations are context rather than newly generated Actor targets.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器的决策使用一组完整的合法 JSON 动作的枚举，其中包含 STOP，因此无法通过组合单独有效的字段来绕过对区域、帧和焦点的联合约束。 检索使用与决策相关的特定 JSON 模式、可用工具以及观察到的证据 ID。 RL 展开过程会保留每个决策的实际输入和约束状态。 旧策略、更新后策略以及参考对数概率是使用相同的合法令牌掩码和采样温度计算的。 工具输出、图像和早期观察结果属于上下文信息，而非新生成的 Actor 目标。

sents.en: Controller decisions use an enumeration of complete legal JSON actions, including STOP , so joint constraints on region, frames, and focus cannot be bypassed by combining individually valid fields.
sents.zh: 控制器的决策使用一组完整的合法 JSON 动作的枚举，其中包含 STOP，因此无法通过组合单独有效的字段来绕过对区域、帧和焦点的联合约束。

sents.en: Retrieval uses the decision-specific JSON schema, available tools, and observed evidence IDs.
sents.zh: 检索使用与决策相关的特定 JSON 模式、可用工具以及观察到的证据 ID。

sents.en: RL rollouts retain the actual input and constraint state for each decision.
sents.zh: RL 展开过程会保留每个决策的实际输入和约束状态。

sents.en: Old-policy, updated-policy, and reference log probabilities are computed with the same legal-token masks and sampling temperature.
sents.zh: 旧策略、更新后策略以及参考对数概率是使用相同的合法令牌掩码和采样温度计算的。

sents.en: Tool outputs, images, and earlier observations are context rather than newly generated Actor targets.
sents.zh: 工具输出、图像和早期观察结果属于上下文信息，而非新生成的 Actor 目标。

paragraphs.en: The LongVT-derived cold-start set contains 4,317 accepted trajectories from 4,205 videos, expanded into 18,932 decision samples. This includes 56 validated retry trajectories added to the initial 4,261. Each sample retains the observation and interaction history available at that decision, while supervising only the final assistant response. The stage establishes the tool-use protocol; it does not supervise the Memory Evolver.
paragraphs.zh: LongVT 衍生的冷启动数据集包含来自 4,205 个视频的 4,317 条已接受轨迹，并扩展为 18,932 个决策样本。 其中包括在初始的 4,261 条基础上添加的 56 条经过验证的重试轨迹。 每个样本都保留了在该决策时刻可用的观察和交互历史，但仅对最终的助手响应进行监督。 该阶段确立了工具使用协议，但不监督 Memory Evolver。

sents.en: The LongVT-derived cold-start set contains 4,317 accepted trajectories from 4,205 videos, expanded into 18,932 decision samples.
sents.zh: LongVT 衍生的冷启动数据集包含来自 4,205 个视频的 4,317 条已接受轨迹，并扩展为 18,932 个决策样本。

sents.en: This includes 56 validated retry trajectories added to the initial 4,261.
sents.zh: 其中包括在初始的 4,261 条基础上添加的 56 条经过验证的重试轨迹。

sents.en: Each sample retains the observation and interaction history available at that decision, while supervising only the final assistant response.
sents.zh: 每个样本都保留了在该决策时刻可用的观察和交互历史，但仅对最终的助手响应进行监督。

sents.en: The stage establishes the tool-use protocol; it does not supervise the Memory Evolver.
sents.zh: 该阶段确立了工具使用协议，但不监督 Memory Evolver。

paragraphs.en: The larger teacher pool on LLaVA videos is filtered for correct final answers, at least one tool action, schema-conformant original JSON responses, valid final references, and available image files. Zero-tool answers, repaired trajectories, and cases flagged for further review are kept separate from this strict training pool. This selection criterion encourages tool-grounded demonstrations; it does not forbid zero-tool answers at inference or amount to a human semantic verification of every rationale.
paragraphs.zh: LLaVA 视频中更大的智能体池会经过筛选，确保其具有正确的最终答案、至少一次工具操作、符合模式的原始 JSON 响应、有效的最终引用以及可用的图像文件。 无工具使用的回答、修复后的轨迹以及被标记为需进一步审查的案例，会与这个严格的训练池分开处理。 这一选择标准鼓励基于工具的演示；它并未禁止在推理阶段使用无工具的回答，也不等同于对每个推理过程进行人工语义验证。

sents.en: The larger teacher pool on LLaVA videos is filtered for correct final answers, at least one tool action, schema-conformant original JSON responses, valid final references, and available image files.
sents.zh: LLaVA 视频中更大的智能体池会经过筛选，确保其具有正确的最终答案、至少一次工具操作、符合模式的原始 JSON 响应、有效的最终引用以及可用的图像文件。

sents.zh: 无工具使用的回答、修复后的轨迹以及被标记为需进一步审查的案例，会与这个严格的训练池分开处理。

sents.en: This selection criterion encourages tool-grounded demonstrations; it does not forbid zero-tool answers at inference or amount to a human semantic verification of every rationale.
sents.zh: 这一选择标准鼓励基于工具的演示；它并未禁止在推理阶段使用无工具的回答，也不等同于对每个推理过程进行人工语义验证。

paragraphs.en: Within the strict pool, trajectories are near-duplicates when they share a video and the complete tool path and their question-word sets have Jaccard similarity at least 0.8. Removing 190 such trajectories reduces the pool from 102,922 to 102,732 complete trajectories across 9,995 videos, yielding 349,717 decision samples. We use this full deduplicated set, not the earlier half-data selection. All decision turns in each retained trajectory are preserved; Stage II starts from the final Stage-I checkpoint rather than from the half-data Stage-II model.
paragraphs.zh: 在严格筛选的池子中，当轨迹共享同一视频和完整的工具路径，且其问题词集合的贾卡德相似度至少为 0.8 时，这些轨迹可视为近乎重复。 移除 190 条此类轨迹后，池子中的完整轨迹数量从 102,922 减少至 102,732，覆盖 9,995 个视频，从而生成 349,717 个决策样本。 我们使用这个经过完全去重后的数据集，而非之前仅选取一半数据的方式。 每条保留轨迹中的所有决策回合均被完整保留；第二阶段从第一阶段的最终检查点开始，而非从使用一半数据的第二阶段模型开始。

sents.en: Within the strict pool, trajectories are near-duplicates when they share a video and the complete tool path and their question-word sets have Jaccard similarity at least 0.8.
sents.zh: 在严格筛选的池子中，当轨迹共享同一视频和完整的工具路径，且其问题词集合的贾卡德相似度至少为 0.8 时，这些轨迹可视为近乎重复。

sents.en: Removing 190 such trajectories reduces the pool from 102,922 to 102,732 complete trajectories across 9,995 videos, yielding 349,717 decision samples.
sents.zh: 移除 190 条此类轨迹后，池子中的完整轨迹数量从 102,922 减少至 102,732，覆盖 9,995 个视频，从而生成 349,717 个决策样本。

sents.en: We use this full deduplicated set, not the earlier half-data selection.
sents.zh: 我们使用这个经过完全去重后的数据集，而非之前仅选取一半数据的方式。

sents.en: All decision turns in each retained trajectory are preserved; Stage II starts from the final Stage-I checkpoint rather than from the half-data Stage-II model.
sents.zh: 每条保留轨迹中的所有决策回合均被完整保留；第二阶段从第一阶段的最终检查点开始，而非从使用一半数据的第二阶段模型开始。

paragraphs.en: Both stages mask prompts and history from the supervised loss and disable sequence packing. Ground-truth labels, correctness flags, provenance metadata, and filtering reasons are not appended to Actor prompts. Stage-II full-input tokenization totals 2,072,137,576 tokens with a maximum sample length of 25,769; these totals include context and are not counts of supervised output tokens. All 349,717 samples pass the recorded no-truncation check, with an additional multimodal-processor cross-check on 128 image-containing samples. Video-ID overlap checks against the available evaluation lists find no overlap; this is ID-based decontamination, not a guarantee against all content-level duplicates. Neither SFT stage holds out an internal validation split.
paragraphs.zh: 两个阶段都会对监督损失中的提示和历史信息进行遮蔽，并禁用序列打包。 真实标签、正确性标志、来源元数据和过滤原因不会附加到 Actor 的提示中。 第二阶段的全输入分词总共有 2,072,137,576 个标记，最大样本长度为 25,769；这些总数包含上下文信息，并非监督输出标记的数量。 全部 349,717 个样本都通过了未截断检查，其中包含图像的 128 个样本还进行了额外的多模态处理器交叉验证。 与可用评估列表进行的 Video-ID 重叠检查未发现任何重叠；这是基于 ID 的去污染，而非对所有内容级重复的保证。 两个 SFT 阶段均未保留内部验证分割集。

sents.en: Both stages mask prompts and history from the supervised loss and disable sequence packing.
sents.zh: 两个阶段都会对监督损失中的提示和历史信息进行遮蔽，并禁用序列打包。

sents.en: Ground-truth labels, correctness flags, provenance metadata, and filtering reasons are not appended to Actor prompts.
sents.zh: 真实标签、正确性标志、来源元数据和过滤原因不会附加到 Actor 的提示中。

sents.zh: 第二阶段的全输入分词总共有 2,072,137,576 个标记，最大样本长度为 25,769；这些总数包含上下文信息，并非监督输出标记的数量。

sents.en: All 349,717 samples pass the recorded no-truncation check, with an additional multimodal-processor cross-check on 128 image-containing samples.
sents.zh: 全部 349,717 个样本都通过了未截断检查，其中包含图像的 128 个样本还进行了额外的多模态处理器交叉验证。

sents.en: Video-ID overlap checks against the available evaluation lists find no overlap; this is ID-based decontamination, not a guarantee against all content-level duplicates.
sents.zh: 与可用评估列表进行的 Video-ID 重叠检查未发现任何重叠；这是基于 ID 的去污染，而非对所有内容级重复的保证。

sents.en: Neither SFT stage holds out an internal validation split.
sents.zh: 两个 SFT 阶段均未保留内部验证分割集。

paragraphs.en: After removing audio-dependent questions from Video-MME-v2, we retain only videos with four complete questions: 514 videos and 2,056 questions for training, and 128 videos and 512 questions for diagnosis. Video and sample IDs are disjoint between the two pools. The diagnostic set is reused for BEF/CEF scheduling and is therefore a development probe, not an independent final test set. Capability labels and answers are available only to scoring and scheduling components. The training questions remain fixed; the framework does not generate new questions online.
paragraphs.zh: 在从 Video-MME-v2 中移除依赖音频的问题后，我们仅保留包含四个完整问题的视频：训练集包含 514 个视频和 2,056 个问题，诊断集包含 128 个视频和 512 个问题。 两个池子中的视频和样本 ID 互不重叠。 诊断集被重复用于 BEF/CEF 调度，因此它是一个开发探针，而非独立的最终测试集。 能力标签和答案仅对评分和调度组件可见。 训练问题保持固定；该框架不会在线生成新问题。

sents.en: After removing audio-dependent questions from Video-MME-v2, we retain only videos with four complete questions: 514 videos and 2,056 questions for training, and 128 videos and 512 questions for diagnosis.
sents.zh: 在从 Video-MME-v2 中移除依赖音频的问题后，我们仅保留包含四个完整问题的视频：训练集包含 514 个视频和 2,056 个问题，诊断集包含 128 个视频和 512 个问题。

sents.en: Video and sample IDs are disjoint between the two pools.
sents.zh: 两个池子中的视频和样本 ID 互不重叠。

sents.en: The diagnostic set is reused for BEF/CEF scheduling and is therefore a development probe, not an independent final test set.
sents.zh: 诊断集被重复用于 BEF/CEF 调度，因此它是一个开发探针，而非独立的最终测试集。

sents.en: Capability labels and answers are available only to scoring and scheduling components.
sents.zh: 能力标签和答案仅对评分和调度组件可见。

sents.en: The training questions remain fixed; the framework does not generate new questions online.
sents.zh: 训练问题保持固定；该框架不会在线生成新问题。

paragraphs.en: At cycle k k , each construction group contains eight candidate trajectories for one video. Candidates start from the fixed Base, while their reward reference is the currently published Enhanced memory M k M^{k} , not the Base. The frozen R k R^{k} scores each candidate and the reference on all four training questions in memory-only mode. After the Controller update, C k + 1 C^{k+1} reconstructs a unified memory and its index for every training video. This is a fresh construction pass, not publication of the best of the eight sampled candidates. Retrieval training then samples four trajectories per question with raw-video access enabled, holding the rebuilt memory fixed. No gradients pass through the Writer, memory files, index, or frozen scorer.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 k 个周期中，每个构建组包含一条视频对应的八条候选轨迹。 候选轨迹从固定的“基础”开始，而它们的奖励参考是当前已发布的增强记忆 M^k，而非“基础”。 冻结的 R^k 在仅使用记忆的模式下，对每条候选轨迹和参考在所有四个训练问题上的得分进行计算。 控制器更新后，C^{k+1} 会为每个训练视频重建一个统一的记忆及其索引。 这是一次全新的构建过程，而非发布从八条采样候选轨迹中挑选出的最佳结果。 随后，检索训练会在启用原始视频访问的情况下，为每个问题采样四条轨迹，同时保持重建的记忆固定不变。 梯度不会通过“写入器”、记忆文件、索引或冻结的评分器。

sents.en: At cycle k k , each construction group contains eight candidate trajectories for one video.
sents.zh: 在第 k 个周期中，每个构建组包含一条视频对应的八条候选轨迹。

sents.en: Candidates start from the fixed Base, while their reward reference is the currently published Enhanced memory M k M^{k} , not the Base.
sents.zh: 候选轨迹从固定的“基础”开始，而它们的奖励参考是当前已发布的增强记忆 M^k，而非“基础”。

sents.en: The frozen R k R^{k} scores each candidate and the reference on all four training questions in memory-only mode.
sents.zh: 冻结的 R^k 在仅使用记忆的模式下，对每条候选轨迹和参考在所有四个训练问题上的得分进行计算。

sents.en: After the Controller update, C k + 1 C^{k+1} reconstructs a unified memory and its index for every training video.
sents.zh: 控制器更新后，C^{k+1} 会为每个训练视频重建一个统一的记忆及其索引。

sents.en: This is a fresh construction pass, not publication of the best of the eight sampled candidates.
sents.zh: 这是一次全新的构建过程，而非发布从八条采样候选轨迹中挑选出的最佳结果。

sents.en: Retrieval training then samples four trajectories per question with raw-video access enabled, holding the rebuilt memory fixed.
sents.zh: 随后，检索训练会在启用原始视频访问的情况下，为每个问题采样四条轨迹，同时保持重建的记忆固定不变。

sents.en: No gradients pass through the Writer, memory files, index, or frozen scorer.
sents.zh: 梯度不会通过“写入器”、记忆文件、索引或冻结的评分器。

paragraphs.en: A Retrieval trajectory is efficiency-eligible only when its final answer is valid and correct. A construction trajectory must be valid, have utility no lower than the current reference, and have nonnegative task reward. For an eligible trajectory i i , 𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} contains the eligible members of its group with the same task reward up to the numerical tolerance defined below. The efficiency term is nonzero only when | 𝒮 i | ≥ 2 |\mathcal{S}_{i}|\geq 2 , and uses β = 0.05 \beta=0.05 . The final advantage is the task advantage plus the efficiency term, with no second normalization and no subtraction of cost before task normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 检索轨迹仅在最终答案有效且正确时，才符合效率条件。 构建轨迹必须有效，其效用不得低于当前参考值，且任务奖励必须为非负数。 对于符合条件的轨迹 i i，𝒮 i \mathcal{S}_{i} 包含其组中任务奖励相同（在下方定义的数值容限范围内）的合格成员。 当且仅当 | 𝒮 i | ≥ 2 |\mathcal{S}_{i}|\geq 2 时，效率项才非零，并使用 β = 0.05 \beta=0.05。 最终优势为任务优势与效率项之和，不进行第二次归一化，也不在任务归一化前减去成本。

paragraphs.en: BEF uses the actual raw-frame count, not merely the availability of view_video . A memory-only failure rescued with positive raw-frame use contributes to construction demand; an unresolved revisit-enabled failure or a rescue without new frames contributes to retrieval demand. These are operational allocation signals, not causal proofs of missing memory or defective reasoning. In particular, failure in both conditions does not establish that memory construction is already adequate.
paragraphs.zh: BEF 使用的是实际的原始帧数量，而不仅仅是 view_video 的可用性。 仅通过有效使用原始帧而得以修复的记忆相关故障会增加构建需求；而未解决的、允许重访的故障或没有新帧的修复则会增加检索需求。 这些是运行时的分配信号，而非记忆缺失或推理缺陷的因果证据。 尤其需要注意的是，两种情况下的故障都无法证明记忆构建已经足够充分。

paragraphs.en: At equal shares, each side receives one full pass: 4,112 construction candidates and 8,224 Retrieval trajectories. With one scorer seed, evaluating the reference and eight candidates on four questions requires 18,504 frozen-scorer trajectories for the construction pass. The shares therefore describe normalized training passes, not equal wall-clock time or GPU cost. Updating fewer construction groups does not eliminate the subsequent full memory/index reconstruction pass.
paragraphs.zh: 在份额相等的情况下，每方都会获得一次完整的处理流程：4,112 个构建候选项和 8,224 条检索轨迹。 使用一个评分器种子时，对四个问题上的参考答案和八个候选项进行评估，构建流程需要 18,504 条固定评分器轨迹。 因此，这些份额描述的是归一化的训练处理流程，而非相等的实际运行时间或 GPU 成本。 更新较少的构建组并不会消除后续完整的内存/索引重建流程。

sents.en: At equal shares, each side receives one full pass: 4,112 construction candidates and 8,224 Retrieval trajectories.
sents.zh: 在份额相等的情况下，每方都会获得一次完整的处理流程：4,112 个构建候选项和 8,224 条检索轨迹。

sents.en: With one scorer seed, evaluating the reference and eight candidates on four questions requires 18,504 frozen-scorer trajectories for the construction pass.
sents.zh: 使用一个评分器种子时，对四个问题上的参考答案和八个候选项进行评估，构建流程需要 18,504 条固定评分器轨迹。

sents.en: The shares therefore describe normalized training passes, not equal wall-clock time or GPU cost.
sents.zh: 因此，这些份额描述的是归一化的训练处理流程，而非相等的实际运行时间或 GPU 成本。

sents.en: Updating fewer construction groups does not eliminate the subsequent full memory/index reconstruction pass.
sents.zh: 更新较少的构建组并不会消除后续完整的内存/索引重建流程。

paragraphs.en: CEF uses the nine non-audio parent categories of Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , retained as the question-level second_head labels in our RL and probe pools. The finer third_head annotations are preserved but are not independently scheduled. We neither relabel questions nor assign a video’s final-question category to all its questions. The categories specify the evidence and reasoning demands of questions, rather than separate model modules:
paragraphs.zh: CEF 使用了 Video-MME-v2 中九个非音频的父类别（Fu et al., 2026），并将其保留为我们在强化学习和探测池中的问题级 second_head 标签。 更精细的 third_head 标注被保留，但并未独立安排训练。 我们既没有重新标记问题，也没有将某个视频的最终问题类别分配给该视频的所有问题。 这些类别定义了问题所需的证据和推理要求，而非独立的模型模块：

sents.en: CEF uses the nine non-audio parent categories of Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , retained as the question-level second_head labels in our RL and probe pools.
sents.zh: CEF 使用了 Video-MME-v2 中九个非音频的父类别（Fu et al., 2026），并将其保留为我们在强化学习和探测池中的问题级 second_head 标签。

sents.en: The finer third_head annotations are preserved but are not independently scheduled.
sents.zh: 更精细的 third_head 标注被保留，但并未独立安排训练。

sents.en: We neither relabel questions nor assign a video’s final-question category to all its questions.
sents.zh: 我们既没有重新标记问题，也没有将某个视频的最终问题类别分配给该视频的所有问题。

sents.en: The categories specify the evidence and reasoning demands of questions, rather than separate model modules:
sents.zh: 这些类别定义了问题所需的证据和推理要求，而非独立的模型模块：

paragraphs.en: Frame-Only. Recognizing entities, attributes, scenes, and visible text; counting objects; and performing simple calculations from visual information. Evidence may be aggregated across frames, but the answer does not require their temporal order. Thus, this label does not impose a single-frame input limit.
paragraphs.zh: 仅帧处理。 从视觉信息中识别实体、属性、场景和可见文本；统计物体数量；并进行简单计算。 证据可以在不同帧之间汇总，但答案不需要考虑这些证据的时间顺序。 因此，该标签并不强制要求单帧输入的限制。

sents.en: Frame-Only.
sents.zh: 仅帧处理。

sents.en: Recognizing entities, attributes, scenes, and visible text; counting objects; and performing simple calculations from visual information.
sents.zh: 从视觉信息中识别实体、属性、场景和可见文本；统计物体数量；并进行简单计算。

sents.en: Evidence may be aggregated across frames, but the answer does not require their temporal order.
sents.zh: 证据可以在不同帧之间汇总，但答案不需要考虑这些证据的时间顺序。

sents.en: Thus, this label does not impose a single-frame input limit.
sents.zh: 因此，该标签并不强制要求单帧输入的限制。

paragraphs.en: Action & Motion. Distinguishing fine-grained actions, counting action repetitions, locating actions in time, and analyzing trajectories and motion properties. These tasks depend on visual dynamics across time rather than static appearance alone.
paragraphs.zh: 动作与运动。 区分精细动作、统计动作重复次数、定位动作发生的时间，以及分析轨迹和运动特性。 这些任务依赖于随时间变化的视觉动态，而不仅仅是静态外观。

sents.en: Action & Motion.
sents.zh: 动作与运动。

sents.en: Distinguishing fine-grained actions, counting action repetitions, locating actions in time, and analyzing trajectories and motion properties.
sents.zh: 区分精细动作、统计动作重复次数、定位动作发生的时间，以及分析轨迹和运动特性。

sents.en: These tasks depend on visual dynamics across time rather than static appearance alone.
sents.zh: 这些任务依赖于随时间变化的视觉动态，而不仅仅是静态外观。

paragraphs.en: Order. Recovering the temporal order of entity appearances or event sequences. The distinguishing requirement is which appearance or event precedes another, rather than merely recognizing the participating entities or events.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序。 恢复实体出现或事件序列的时间顺序。 区分的关键在于判断哪个出现或事件先于另一个，而不仅仅是识别参与其中的实体或事件。

sents.en: Order.
sents.zh: 顺序。

sents.en: Recovering the temporal order of entity appearances or event sequences.
sents.zh: 恢复实体出现或事件序列的时间顺序。

sents.en: The distinguishing requirement is which appearance or event precedes another, rather than merely recognizing the participating entities or events.
sents.zh: 区分的关键在于判断哪个出现或事件先于另一个，而不仅仅是识别参与其中的实体或事件。

paragraphs.en: Change. Comparing entity existence, attributes, or scene states across time, and detecting periodic or cyclic patterns. These questions require relating observations at different moments to identify what changed or recurred.
paragraphs.zh: 变化。 比较实体存在、属性或场景状态随时间的变化，并检测周期性或循环模式。 这些问题需要将不同时刻的观察结果联系起来，以识别发生了什么变化或重复出现的情况。

sents.en: Change.
sents.zh: 变化。

sents.en: Comparing entity existence, attributes, or scene states across time, and detecting periodic or cyclic patterns.
sents.zh: 比较实体存在、属性或场景状态随时间的变化，并检测周期性或循环模式。

sents.en: These questions require relating observations at different moments to identify what changed or recurred.
sents.zh: 这些问题需要将不同时刻的观察结果联系起来，以识别发生了什么变化或重复出现的情况。

paragraphs.en: Temporal Reasoning. Inferring video-grounded cause–effect relations and predicting subsequent events from observed dynamics. Unlike Order, this category requires an inference about why an event occurs or what is likely to follow, not only chronological sorting.
paragraphs.zh: 时序推理。 从观察到的动态中推断基于视频的因果关系，并预测后续事件。 与“顺序”不同，这一类别不仅需要按时间排序，还需要对事件发生的原因或可能发生的后续情况进行推断。

sents.en: Temporal Reasoning.
sents.zh: 时序推理。

sents.en: Inferring video-grounded cause–effect relations and predicting subsequent events from observed dynamics.
sents.zh: 从观察到的动态中推断基于视频的因果关系，并预测后续事件。

sents.en: Unlike Order, this category requires an inference about why an event occurs or what is likely to follow, not only chronological sorting.
sents.zh: 与“顺序”不同，这一类别不仅需要按时间排序，还需要对事件发生的原因或可能发生的后续情况进行推断。

paragraphs.en: Complex Plot Comprehension. Integrating narrative evidence to identify turning points, infer unstated implications, interpret symbolism or metaphor, and understand higher-order storytelling structure. Relevant clues may be distributed across multiple scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂情节理解。 整合叙事证据，识别转折点，推断未明说的含义，解读象征或隐喻，并理解更高级的叙事结构。 相关线索可能分布在多个场景中。

sents.en: Complex Plot Comprehension.
sents.zh: 复杂情节理解。

sents.en: Integrating narrative evidence to identify turning points, infer unstated implications, interpret symbolism or metaphor, and understand higher-order storytelling structure.
sents.zh: 整合叙事证据，识别转折点，推断未明说的含义，解读象征或隐喻，并理解更高级的叙事结构。

sents.en: Relevant clues may be distributed across multiple scenes.
sents.zh: 相关线索可能分布在多个场景中。

paragraphs.en: Video-Based Knowledge Acquisition. Understanding domain knowledge or practical procedures presented in the video, including demonstrated steps, conditions, and error checks. Answers must depend on the presented content rather than generic background knowledge alone.
paragraphs.zh: 基于视频的知识获取。 理解视频中呈现的领域知识或实用流程，包括演示的步骤、条件和错误检查。 答案必须依赖所呈现的内容，而不能仅依赖通用的背景知识。

sents.en: Video-Based Knowledge Acquisition.
sents.zh: 基于视频的知识获取。

sents.en: Understanding domain knowledge or practical procedures presented in the video, including demonstrated steps, conditions, and error checks.
sents.zh: 理解视频中呈现的领域知识或实用流程，包括演示的步骤、条件和错误检查。

sents.en: Answers must depend on the presented content rather than generic background knowledge alone.
sents.zh: 答案必须依赖所呈现的内容，而不能仅依赖通用的背景知识。

paragraphs.en: Social Behavior Analysis. Inferring individual intentions, emotions, or mental states, and analyzing interactions between two people or group-level roles, cooperation, and conflict from contextual evidence across time.
paragraphs.zh: 社会行为分析。 根据随时间变化的上下文证据，推断个体的意图、情绪或心理状态，并分析两人之间的互动、群体层面的角色、合作与冲突。

sents.en: Social Behavior Analysis.
sents.zh: 社会行为分析。

sents.en: Inferring individual intentions, emotions, or mental states, and analyzing interactions between two people or group-level roles, cooperation, and conflict from contextual evidence across time.
sents.zh: 根据随时间变化的上下文证据，推断个体的意图、情绪或心理状态，并分析两人之间的互动、群体层面的角色、合作与冲突。

paragraphs.en: Physical World Reasoning. Reasoning about entity persistence, three-dimensional spatial relations, grounded counterfactuals, and counterintuitive physical phenomena. The task is to connect observations to physical continuity or constraints, rather than only report visible attributes.
paragraphs.zh: 物理世界推理。 对实体持续性、三维空间关系、基于现实的反事实推论以及反直觉的物理现象进行推理。 该任务要求将观察结果与物理连续性或约束条件联系起来，而不仅仅是报告可见的属性。

sents.en: Physical World Reasoning.
sents.zh: 物理世界推理。

sents.en: Reasoning about entity persistence, three-dimensional spatial relations, grounded counterfactuals, and counterintuitive physical phenomena.
sents.zh: 对实体持续性、三维空间关系、基于现实的反事实推论以及反直觉的物理现象进行推理。

sents.en: The task is to connect observations to physical continuity or constraints, rather than only report visible attributes.
sents.zh: 该任务要求将观察结果与物理连续性或约束条件联系起来，而不仅仅是报告可见的属性。

paragraphs.en: These labels remain outside both Actor prompts. In particular, the Memory Evolver receives neither a question nor a requested capability: it constructs one reusable memory per video. CEF changes which labeled training instances are sampled, without adding capability-specific heads, prompts, rewards, or new questions.
paragraphs.zh: 这些标签仍然位于两个智能体提示之外。 具体来说，记忆演化器既没有接收到问题，也没有收到所需能力的请求：它为每个视频构建一个可重用的记忆。 CEF 改变了哪些带标签的训练实例会被采样，但没有添加与特定能力相关的头、提示、奖励或新问题。

sents.zh: 这些标签仍然位于两个智能体提示之外。

sents.zh: CEF 改变了哪些带标签的训练实例会被采样，但没有添加与特定能力相关的头、提示、奖励或新问题。

paragraphs.en: Thus, raw-frame-assisted rescues within a category contribute to its construction demand, whereas unresolved revisit-enabled errors and rescues without new frames contribute to its retrieval demand. The two estimates and sampling distributions are maintained separately: one capability can require different training emphasis on the two sides. These are the same operational proxies used by BEF, now conditioned on capability, not independent measurements of an isolated latent skill.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，某一类别中由原始帧辅助的救援会促进其构建需求，而未解决的、通过重访实现的错误以及没有新帧的救援则会促进其检索需求。 这两种估计值和采样分布是分开维护的：某项能力可能需要在两个方面采取不同的训练重点。 这些与 BEF 使用的操作代理相同，但现在它们以能力为条件，而非基于对孤立潜在技能的独立测量。

sents.en: Thus, raw-frame-assisted rescues within a category contribute to its construction demand, whereas unresolved revisit-enabled errors and rescues without new frames contribute to its retrieval demand.

paragraphs.en: The initial sufficiently supported probe initializes each demand estimate; subsequent estimates use EMA coefficient α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 . A missing observation or support from fewer than ten distinct probe videos retains the previous estimate, or zero if none is available. We set ρ = 0.3 \rho=0.3 : each Evolver’s target distribution mixes 30% uniform coverage over K = 9 K=9 categories with 70% normalized smoothed demand. If all demand estimates are zero, the target is uniform.

sents.en: A missing observation or support from fewer than ten distinct probe videos retains the previous estimate, or zero if none is available.
