This projection preserves all bounds jointly; independently clipping each weight and then renormalizing need not do so. sents.zh: 这种投影能同时保留所有界限；而分别对每个权重进行裁剪再重新归一化则未必能做到这一点。

sents.en: BEF controls the numbers of training groups, while CEF controls their within-role capability composition.
sents.zh: BEF 控制训练组的数量，而 CEF 则控制其角色内的能力构成。

paragraphs.en: Cycle 0 makes one full pass over all training videos for construction and all training questions for retrieval. Subsequent cycles use the feedback distributions within BEF’s group budgets. For Retrieval, we first draw c c according to w R , c k + 1 w_{R,c}^{k+1} and then draw a training question with that label. For construction, we draw c c according to w C , c k + 1 w_{C,c}^{k+1} and select a video containing at least one question of that category. A video can therefore belong to several construction buckets. Each video is selected at most twice per cycle; once this cap is reached it is excluded, and capability sampling uses the remaining weights restricted to categories with eligible videos.
paragraphs.zh: 第 0 轮会对所有训练视频进行一次完整遍历以进行构建，并对所有训练问题进行检索。 后续各轮会使用 BEF 组内预算中的反馈分布。 对于检索，我们首先根据 w R , c k + 1 w_{R,c}^{k+1} 抽取 c c，然后抽取一个具有该标签的训练问题。 对于构建，我们根据 w C , c k + 1 w_{C,c}^{k+1} 抽取 c c，并选择一个至少包含一个该类别问题的视频。 因此，一个视频可以属于多个构建桶。 每个视频每轮最多被选择两次；一旦达到这一上限，该视频将被排除，而能力采样将使用仅限于包含合格视频的类别的剩余权重。

sents.en: Cycle 0 makes one full pass over all training videos for construction and all training questions for retrieval.
sents.zh: 第 0 轮会对所有训练视频进行一次完整遍历以进行构建，并对所有训练问题进行检索。

sents.en: Subsequent cycles use the feedback distributions within BEF’s group budgets.
sents.zh: 后续各轮会使用 BEF 组内预算中的反馈分布。

sents.en: For Retrieval, we first draw c c according to w R , c k + 1 w_{R,c}^{k+1} and then draw a training question with that label.
sents.zh: 对于检索，我们首先根据 w R , c k + 1 w_{R,c}^{k+1} 抽取 c c，然后抽取一个具有该标签的训练问题。

sents.en: For construction, we draw c c according to w C , c k + 1 w_{C,c}^{k+1} and select a video containing at least one question of that category.
sents.zh: 对于构建，我们根据 w C , c k + 1 w_{C,c}^{k+1} 抽取 c c，并选择一个至少包含一个该类别问题的视频。

sents.en: A video can therefore belong to several construction buckets.
sents.zh: 因此，一个视频可以属于多个构建桶。

sents.en: Each video is selected at most twice per cycle; once this cap is reached it is excluded, and capability sampling uses the remaining weights restricted to categories with eligible videos.
sents.zh: 每个视频每轮最多被选择两次；一旦达到这一上限，该视频将被排除，而能力采样将使用仅限于包含合格视频的类别的剩余权重。

paragraphs.en: Within the selected capability bucket, a branch is drawn with probabilities 0.6, 0.2, and 0.2, respectively; these are sampling probabilities, not exact finite-batch quotas. Retrieval frontier questions have at least two valid historical revisit-enabled trajectories with both correct and incorrect outcomes; retention questions have only correct valid outcomes. Construction frontier videos have a four-question utility range greater than 10 − 8 10^{-8} within a complete, valid candidate group evaluated by the same frozen scorer. Retention videos have at least one complete valid group in which every candidate answers all four questions correctly. Comparisons across different scorer versions are not used to establish construction frontier membership.
paragraphs.zh: 在选定的能力桶内，会按照 0.6、0.2 和 0.2 的概率分别抽取一个分支；这些是采样概率，而非精确的有限批次配额。 检索前沿问题至少存在两条有效的历史重访可用轨迹，且结果同时包含正确与错误；保留问题则仅有正确的有效结果。 构建前沿视频在由同一冻结评分器评估的完整有效候选组中，其四道题的效用范围大于 10^{-8}。 保留视频至少存在一个完整的有效组，其中每个候选者都能正确回答全部四道题。 不同版本评分器之间的比较不用于确定构建前沿的成员资格。

sents.en: Within the selected capability bucket, a branch is drawn with probabilities 0.6, 0.2, and 0.2, respectively; these are sampling probabilities, not exact finite-batch quotas.
sents.zh: 在选定的能力桶内，会按照 0.6、0.2 和 0.2 的概率分别抽取一个分支；这些是采样概率，而非精确的有限批次配额。

sents.en: Retrieval frontier questions have at least two valid historical revisit-enabled trajectories with both correct and incorrect outcomes; retention questions have only correct valid outcomes.
sents.zh: 检索前沿问题至少存在两条有效的历史重访可用轨迹，且结果同时包含正确与错误；保留问题则仅有正确的有效结果。

sents.en: Construction frontier videos have a four-question utility range greater than 10 − 8 10^{-8} within a complete, valid candidate group evaluated by the same frozen scorer.
sents.zh: 构建前沿视频在由同一冻结评分器评估的完整有效候选组中，其四道题的效用范围大于 10^{-8}。

sents.en: Retention videos have at least one complete valid group in which every candidate answers all four questions correctly.
sents.zh: 保留视频至少存在一个完整的有效组，其中每个候选者都能正确回答全部四道题。

sents.en: Comparisons across different scorer versions are not used to establish construction frontier membership.
sents.zh: 不同版本评分器之间的比较不用于确定构建前沿的成员资格。

paragraphs.en: Exploration samples uniformly from the full eligible bucket, including previously unseen, failed, and successful instances. A frontier or retention branch with no candidates falls back to this full bucket; otherwise sampling is uniform within the chosen branch. Construction frontier takes precedence over retention when both apply. This mixture emphasizes observed variation while maintaining access to unsolved cases and opportunities to retain successful behavior. Historical frontier membership is an empirical indicator of useful variation, not a guarantee of learnability.
paragraphs.zh: 探索样本从完整的合格候选池中进行均匀采样，包括此前未见过、失败和成功的实例。 若前沿或保留分支中没有候选项，则回退到使用这个完整候选池；否则，采样将在所选分支内部均匀进行。 当构造前沿和保留分支同时适用时，构造前沿具有优先权。 这种混合策略既强调了已观察到的变异性，又保留了访问未解决案例以及保留成功行为的机会。 历史前沿成员资格是有效变异性的经验指标，而非可学习性的保证。

sents.en: Exploration samples uniformly from the full eligible bucket, including previously unseen, failed, and successful instances.
sents.zh: 探索样本从完整的合格候选池中进行均匀采样，包括此前未见过、失败和成功的实例。

sents.en: A frontier or retention branch with no candidates falls back to this full bucket; otherwise sampling is uniform within the chosen branch.
sents.zh: 若前沿或保留分支中没有候选项，则回退到使用这个完整候选池；否则，采样将在所选分支内部均匀进行。

sents.en: Construction frontier takes precedence over retention when both apply.
sents.zh: 当构造前沿和保留分支同时适用时，构造前沿具有优先权。

sents.en: This mixture emphasizes observed variation while maintaining access to unsolved cases and opportunities to retain successful behavior.
sents.zh: 这种混合策略既强调了已观察到的变异性，又保留了访问未解决案例以及保留成功行为的机会。

sents.en: Historical frontier membership is an empirical indicator of useful variation, not a guarantee of learnability.
sents.zh: 历史前沿成员资格是有效变异性的经验指标，而非可学习性的保证。

paragraphs.en: Every selected instance generates fresh on-policy rollouts; previous-cycle outcomes determine sampling only, and probe examples never enter the gradient-training pool. A selected construction video produces eight Controller trajectories from the fixed Base. The frozen Retrieval policy scores their memories and the current reference on all four associated questions with equal weight, even when the video was selected for only one capability. The group-relative, quality-first objective in Sec. 3.4 updates the Controller’s choices of where to observe, how many frames to request, what to extract, and when to stop. Capability targeting thus changes exposure to videos with particular evidence demands, not the four-question reward or the frozen Writer.
paragraphs.zh: 每个被选中的实例都会生成新的策略内展开；上一周期的结果仅用于确定采样，而探测示例绝不会进入梯度训练池。 一个被选中的构建视频会从固定的基础模型中产生八条控制器轨迹。 冻结的检索策略会以相等的权重，针对所有四个相关问题对它们的记忆和当前参考进行评分，即使该视频仅因某一项能力而被选中。 第 3.4 节中基于群体相对性、以质量优先的目标，会更新控制器在何处观察、请求多少帧、提取什么内容以及何时停止的选择。 因此，能力靶向会改变对具有特定证据需求的视频的接触程度，但不会影响四问题奖励或冻结的写入器。

sents.en: Every selected instance generates fresh on-policy rollouts; previous-cycle outcomes determine sampling only, and probe examples never enter the gradient-training pool.
sents.zh: 每个被选中的实例都会生成新的策略内展开；上一周期的结果仅用于确定采样，而探测示例绝不会进入梯度训练池。

sents.en: A selected construction video produces eight Controller trajectories from the fixed Base.
sents.zh: 一个被选中的构建视频会从固定的基础模型中产生八条控制器轨迹。

sents.en: The frozen Retrieval policy scores their memories and the current reference on all four associated questions with equal weight, even when the video was selected for only one capability.
sents.zh: 冻结的检索策略会以相等的权重，针对所有四个相关问题对它们的记忆和当前参考进行评分，即使该视频仅因某一项能力而被选中。

sents.en: The group-relative, quality-first objective in Sec. 3.4 updates the Controller’s choices of where to observe, how many frames to request, what to extract, and when to stop.
sents.zh: 第 3.4 节中基于群体相对性、以质量优先的目标，会更新控制器在何处观察、请求多少帧、提取什么内容以及何时停止的选择。

sents.en: Capability targeting thus changes exposure to videos with particular evidence demands, not the four-question reward or the frozen Writer.
sents.zh: 因此，能力靶向会改变对具有特定证据需求的视频的接触程度，但不会影响四问题奖励或冻结的写入器。

paragraphs.en: After updating the Controller, we rebuild all training memories and indexes. Each selected Retrieval question generates four revisit-enabled trajectories over the fixed rebuilt memory, and quality-first RL updates evidence acquisition, reasoning, and answering. A new paired probe then sets the next-cycle focus. For Order, construction demand prioritizes videos containing ordering questions, whereas retrieval demand prioritizes those questions, without prescribing tool sequences. This is a mechanism illustration, not a measured capability gain. BEF and CEF remain training-only.
paragraphs.zh: 更新控制器后，我们会重建所有训练记忆和索引。 每个选定的检索问题都会在固定的重建记忆上生成四条支持重访的轨迹，而质量优先的强化学习则会更新证据获取、推理和回答过程。 随后，一个新的配对探针将设定下一轮的重点。 对于“顺序”任务，构建需求会优先选择包含排序问题的视频，而检索需求则优先选择这些问题本身，但不会规定工具的使用顺序。 这是一个机制示意图，而非实际能力提升的测量结果。 BEF 和 CEF 仍仅用于训练。

sents.en: After updating the Controller, we rebuild all training memories and indexes.
sents.zh: 更新控制器后，我们会重建所有训练记忆和索引。

sents.en: Each selected Retrieval question generates four revisit-enabled trajectories over the fixed rebuilt memory, and quality-first RL updates evidence acquisition, reasoning, and answering.

sents.en: BEF and CEF remain training-only.
sents.zh: BEF 和 CEF 仍仅用于训练。

paragraphs.en: The limits in Table distinguish model output allowances from accepted memory text. A Writer may generate up to 2,048 tokens for structured output while at most 256 description tokens are accepted at one step. During RL, an invalid Controller decision is recorded without hidden policy resampling. The standalone build mode permits one explicit correction attempt per stage with validation feedback; Writer format repair and bounded transport retries are separate mechanisms. None of these retries constitutes evidence verification or a new learned component.
paragraphs.zh: 表格中的限制区分了模型输出配额与可接受的记忆文本。 写作者可以为结构化输出生成最多 2,048 个词元，而每一步最多只能接受 256 个描述词元。 在强化学习过程中，如果控制器的决策无效，则会被记录，但不会重新采样隐藏策略。 独立构建模式允许每个阶段进行一次显式修正尝试并获取验证反馈；写作者格式修复与有界传输重试则是独立的机制。 这些重试均不构成证据验证或新的学习组件。

paragraphs.en: The main experiments report multiple-choice accuracy on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, MLVU, and MMVU. Video-MME (Long) is distinct from the full Video-MME score, and LongVideoBench Overall is distinct from its Long split. Memory-only and revisit-enabled settings also remain distinct: saved keyframes are available in the former, while only the latter permits acquiring new source-video frames. Accordingly, a single global “128-frame input” limit does not describe this multi-stage system. Literature results retain their source-specific backbones, input modalities, and evaluation protocols rather than being re-evaluated under our runtime budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 主要实验报告了 Video-MME、LongVideoBench、LVBench、MLVU 和 MMVU 上的多选准确率。 Video-MME (Long) 与完整的 Video-MME 分数不同，而 LongVideoBench Overall 也与其 Long 分集不同。 仅使用内存的设置与启用重看的设置也保持区别：前者可以使用已保存的关键帧，而后者则只允许获取新的源视频帧。 因此，单一的“128 帧输入”全局限制无法描述这个多阶段系统。 文献中的结果保留了各自来源特定的骨干网络、输入模态和评估协议，而不是在我们的运行时预算下重新评估。

paragraphs.en: The full method is trained for four complete co-evolution cycles, each comprising a Controller update, memory reconstruction, and a Retrieval update. Final benchmark evaluation uses the paired Controller and Retrieval checkpoints after the third cycle, rather than the fourth-cycle checkpoints. The same pair is used across all five benchmarks, without benchmark-specific checkpoint selection. The optimization-objective variants follow the same four-cycle training and third-cycle evaluation rule, as detailed in Appendix A.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 完整方法经过四个完整的协同进化周期训练，每个周期包括一次控制器更新、记忆重建和一次检索更新。 最终基准评估使用第三个周期后的配对控制器和检索检查点，而非第四个周期的检查点。 在所有五个基准测试中均使用同一对检查点，不针对特定基准选择检查点。 优化目标变体遵循相同的四周期训练和第三周期评估规则，具体细节见附录 A.9。

sents.en: The full method is trained for four complete co-evolution cycles, each comprising a Controller update, memory reconstruction, and a Retrieval update.
sents.zh: 完整方法经过四个完整的协同进化周期训练，每个周期包括一次控制器更新、记忆重建和一次检索更新。

sents.en: Final benchmark evaluation uses the paired Controller and Retrieval checkpoints after the third cycle, rather than the fourth-cycle checkpoints.
sents.zh: 最终基准评估使用第三个周期后的配对控制器和检索检查点，而非第四个周期的检查点。

sents.en: The same pair is used across all five benchmarks, without benchmark-specific checkpoint selection.
sents.zh: 在所有五个基准测试中均使用同一对检查点，不针对特定基准选择检查点。

sents.en: The optimization-objective variants follow the same four-cycle training and third-cycle evaluation rule, as detailed in Appendix A.9 .
sents.zh: 优化目标变体遵循相同的四周期训练和第三周期评估规则，具体细节见附录 A.9。

paragraphs.en: We use the complete official evaluation sets of Video-MME and LVBench, the full official validation split of LongVideoBench, all multiple-choice tasks in the MLVU development split, and the multiple-choice portion of the MMVU test split. The Video-MME and LongVideoBench Long results follow the official duration-based subsets. MLVU is reported as the unweighted mean of the individual task accuracies, rather than accuracy pooled over all questions. The core, design, and cold-start ablations use the same evaluation sets and aggregation rules as the main experiments, without separately sampled question subsets.

paragraphs.en: Memory construction operates per video, whereas retrieval and answering operate per question. For the training-based model, the learned Controller constructs a question-independent Delta from the video’s fixed Base; the resulting memory and its index are reused across that video’s questions. Each question is then answered independently, without policy updates at test time. In Table 1 , the two Video-MME columns report overall accuracy without and with subtitles, respectively. The overall Video-MME columns in Tables 3 and 8 use the with-subtitles setting. Their Long columns, and the Long-subset results in Table 6 , are separate metrics rather than alternative names for the overall scores. Table 7 adds LongVideoBench Overall and LVBench results for the corresponding design variants.

In the without-subtitles Video-MME setting, no external subtitles or ASR text are supplied during Base construction, Delta augmentation, or question answering; text visible in the video frames remains available. The Video-MME Long columns in the core, design, and cold-start ablations use the with-subtitles protocol. paragraphs.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, Retrieval uses greedy decoding with temperature zero at benchmark evaluation. Controller decisions for final memory construction and Writer calls for Base extraction, higher-level aggregation, and Delta augmentation also use greedy decoding. The Controller, supplemental Writer, and Retrieval retain context/output limits of 48,000/512, 12,000/2,048, and 65,536/8,192 tokens, respectively (Table ). These settings concern final evaluation, not sampled training trajectories or diagnostic rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于训练的模式及其消融研究，Retrieval 在基准评估中使用温度为零的贪心解码。 Controller 在最终记忆构建中的决策，以及 Writer 在执行基础提取、更高级别的聚合和 Delta 增强时的调用，也使用贪心解码。 Controller、辅助 Writer 和 Retrieval 分别保留 48,000/512、12,000/2,048 和 65,536/8,192 个词元的上下文/输出限制（见表格）。 这些设置涉及最终评估，而非采样训练轨迹或诊断性运行。

paragraphs.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, we run question answering four times with seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} and report the arithmetic mean of the four accuracies, using the benchmark-specific aggregation rules above. Each configuration’s memory and index remain fixed across the four runs; neither Base nor Delta is reconstructed between them. The repetitions concern inference with fixed checkpoints and memory, not independent training runs or independently sampled memory constructions. Greedy decoding is retained in all four runs; the seed settings do not imply stochastic answer sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于训练模型及其消融实验，我们使用种子 { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} 运行四次问答任务，并依据上述针对该基准测试的聚合规则，报告四次准确率的算术平均值。 每次配置在四次运行中均保持内存和索引不变；Base 和 Delta 均未在运行之间被重新构建。 这些重复操作涉及使用固定检查点和内存进行的推理，而非独立的训练运行或独立采样的内存构建。 所有四次运行均保留贪心解码策略；种子设置并不意味着答案的随机采样。

paragraphs.en: The implemented multiple-choice scorer normalizes the prediction and reference to option labels and checks exact equality; it does not invoke an LLM judge or grade the reasoning text. Reference answers are supplied only to the scorer after the policy finishes. With a valid reference label, abstentions and invalid terminal decisions that yield no answer receive zero correctness, whereas an invalid intermediate action can still be followed by a correct final answer. Technical execution failures are recorded separately as unscored outcomes, not conflated with policy abstention or invalid termination. Runtime summaries retain scored and unscored counts separately; final benchmark reporting follows the completion protocol below rather than dropping technical failures from the denominator.
paragraphs.zh: 已实现的选择题评分器将预测结果和参考答案归约为选项标签，并检查是否完全相等；它不会调用 LLM 裁判或给推理文本打分。 只有在策略执行结束后，参考答案才会提供给评分器。 在有有效参考标签的情况下，弃权以及未产生答案的无效终止决策将获得零正确性分数，而无效的中间动作之后仍可能接一个正确的最终答案。 技术执行失败将作为未得分结果单独记录，不会与策略弃权或无效终止混为一谈。 运行时摘要会分别保留得分和未得分的次数；最终的基准测试报告遵循下述完成协议，而不是将技术失败从分母中排除。

paragraphs.en: For the training-based model and its ablations, only technical execution failures are rerun, retaining the affected run’s original seed, checkpoints, memory, and budgets. Completed outcomes are preserved: incorrect answers, abstentions, and invalid policy terminations are not retried. All technical failures are resolved before final aggregation, so each of the four runs covers the full specified evaluation set. Accuracy uses the complete set for the corresponding benchmark, subset, or MLVU task; abstentions and invalid terminations without a valid answer count as incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 对于基于训练的模式及其消融实验，仅对技术执行失败进行重新运行，同时保留受影响运行的原始种子、检查点、内存和预算。 已完成的结果将被保留：错误答案、弃权以及无效的策略终止将不再重试。 所有技术故障在最终汇总前均会得到解决，因此四次运行中的每一次都覆盖了完整的指定评估集。 准确率使用对应基准测试、子集或 MLVU 任务的完整数据集进行计算；弃权以及在没有有效答案的情况下发生的无效终止均计为错误。

paragraphs.en: The full model permits raw-video revisiting on all five benchmarks, including both Video-MME subtitle conditions. Memory-only is not text-only: the policy can inspect stored keyframes as well as memory records. Revisit-enabled inference additionally permits new source-video observations through view_video ; the policy may still finish without using this tool. The question-time allowance is 64 new frames in total, with at most 16 per call, and is separate from both Base sampling and the duration-dependent augmentation budget in Eq. 15 . The interaction protocol in Appendix A.2 provides 12 exploration slots and, if needed, a final-only decision. Invalid intermediate actions consume a slot without executing a tool. Consequently, the revisiting ablation concerns access to new source frames, not removal of stored visual evidence or changes to the Writer’s parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 完整模型支持在所有五个基准测试中对原始视频进行重新访问，包括 Video-MME 的两种字幕条件。 仅使用内存的模式并非仅使用文本：策略可以检查存储的关键帧以及内存记录。 启用重新访问的推理还允许通过 view_video 获取新的源视频观察信息；策略仍可能在不使用该工具的情况下完成任务。 问题处理时间总共允许 64 个新帧，每次调用最多使用 16 帧，且与 Base 采样以及公式 15 中依赖时长的增强预算相互独立。 附录 A.2 中的交互协议提供了 12 个探索槽位，并在需要时允许仅做出最终决策。 无效的中间动作会占用一个槽位，但不会执行任何工具。 因此，重新访问的消融研究涉及对源视频新帧的访问权限，而非移除已存储的视觉证据或更改 Writer 的参数。

paragraphs.en: The 512-question paired probe in Appendix A.5 is used to schedule subsequent training, not to replace any of the five benchmark evaluations. The probe uses temperature 0.7; final benchmark evaluation instead uses the greedy protocol above, despite sharing the four seed values. BEF and CEF are inactive during benchmark inference: their effect is carried by the learned policies, rather than by further optimization on evaluation questions.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A.5 中的 512 道配对探测题用于安排后续训练，而非替代五种基准评估中的任何一种。 该探测题使用温度为 0.7；而最终的基准评估则采用上述贪心策略，尽管两者共享四个种子值。 BEF 和 CEF 在基准推理过程中处于非激活状态：其影响由已学习的策略承载，而非通过评估问题上的进一步优化实现。

Table 1 covers proprietary models alongside open-source reasoning-enhanced and video-revisiting/tool-based baselines, including their reported results on MMVU ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Memory-based methods may also revisit video evidence; tool use alone does not determine the category.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将查询时的视频访问与显式的基于记忆的推理区分开来。 表 1 涵盖了专有模型，以及经过增强推理和基于视频重访/工具的开源基线模型，包括它们在 MMVU（Zhao 等人，2025）上报告的结果。 基于记忆的方法也可能重新查看视频证据；仅使用工具并不能决定其类别。

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 , “Baseline” denotes Qwen3-VL-8B used within our tool-enabled framework without task-specific training of the model. We report our own evaluation for this row. It uses Base memory only, with the same Qwen3.8-27B Writer and Base construction procedure as the training-free variant, and does not run a memory-augmentation Controller or construct a Delta. Neither deployed model undergoes task-specific parameter updates in this study. Across the five benchmarks, the baseline follows the training-based model’s evaluation sets, subtitle inputs for Base construction, retrieval tools, and budgets, including raw-video revisiting. It also uses greedy decoding, a Retrieval context/output limit of 65,536/8,192 tokens, and the same four-run accuracy averaging with fixed Base and index, seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} , and technical-failure-only completion protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 1 中，“Baseline”表示在我们的工具增强框架内使用的 Qwen3-VL-8B，且该模型未进行任务特定的训练。 我们报告了此行的自身评估结果。 它仅使用 Base 内存，并采用与无训练版本相同的 Qwen3.8-27B Writer 和 Base 构建流程，同时不运行内存增强 Controller 或构建 Delta。 在本研究中，两个部署的模型均未进行任务特定的参数更新。 在五个基准测试中，Baseline 遵循基于训练的模型的评估集、Base 构建的副标题输入、检索工具及预算限制，包括对原始视频的重新访问。 它还使用贪心解码、65,536/8,192 个词元的检索上下文/输出限制，以及相同的四轮准确率平均方法（固定 Base 和索引种子为 { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\}），并采用仅处理技术故障的完成协议。

paragraphs.en: Among the literature baselines in Table 1 , results follow ParaVT ( Yang et al., 2026b ) except for VideoZoomer’s original Video-MME overall (65.2), LongVideoBench validation (57.7), LVBench (41.5), and MLVU dev (68.8) results ( Ding et al., 2026 ) . These original results use up to 128 frames, whereas ParaVT reports 64-frame re-evaluations. VideoZoomer’s 65.2 is listed under w/o subtitles, with “–” under w/ subtitles. Its MMVU entry retains ParaVT’s result, since the original paper reports VideoMMLU and VideoMMMU, not MMVU. This row therefore combines source-specific evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 在表 1 中的文献基线方法中，结果均低于 ParaVT（Yang et al., 2026b），但 VideoZoomer 的原始 Video-MME 总体得分（65.2）、LongVideoBench 验证集得分（57.7）、LVBench 得分（41.5）以及 MLVU 开发集得分（68.8）（Ding et al., 2026）除外。 这些原始结果最多使用了 128 帧，而 ParaVT 报告的是基于 64 帧的重新评估结果。 VideoZoomer 的 65.2 分列在“无字幕”类别下，而在“有字幕”类别下则显示为“–”。 其 MMVU 条目保留了 ParaVT 的结果，因为原始论文报告的是 VideoMMLU 和 VideoMMMU，而非 MMVU。 因此，这一行结合了针对特定数据源的评价结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 lists seven prior methods and both VideoEvolve variants, grouped into training-free and training-based approaches. Following the terminology in the main text, Memory Construction lists the primary memory-writing model or module, and Retrieval lists the main retrieval/answering model; neither column enumerates every auxiliary component. Training-free refers to a memory and retrieval procedure without additional parameter optimization; it does not imply that all component models are untrained. Reusable memory is constructed without the downstream question, whereas query-conditioned memory is updated for each question. MemVid’s KV-cache memorizer is a latent-memory module rather than a caption writer.
paragraphs.zh: 表2列出了七种先前的方法以及两种VideoEvolve变体，并将其分为无需训练和基于训练的方法。 遵循正文中的术语，“记忆构建”列出了主要的记忆写入模型或模块，“检索”列出了主要的检索/回答模型；两列均未列出所有辅助组件。 “无需训练”指记忆和检索过程不涉及额外的参数优化；这并不意味着所有组件模型均未经过训练。 可重复使用的记忆是在没有下游问题的情况下构建的，而查询条件化的记忆则针对每个问题进行更新。 MemVid的KV缓存记忆器是一个潜在记忆模块，而非标题生成器。

paragraphs.en: EgoRAG ( Yang et al., 2025 ) builds hierarchical textual memory from clip captions and higher-level summaries. Its original EgoLife experiments vary the captioner, use GPT-4o for final responses in the main evaluation, and also study EgoGPT-based answering. Although EgoGPT is fine-tuned, EgoRAG’s hierarchical retrieval procedure itself does not introduce parameter optimization; this is the basis for its grouping in our table. The original paper does not report LVBench or Video-MME (Long) accuracy. We therefore use WorldMM’s results of 32.2 and 41.1, respectively. WorldMM identifies a proprietary backbone but does not explicitly specify the captioner/answerer pairing for this evaluation, so both model entries are shown as “–.”
paragraphs.zh: EgoRAG（Yang 等人，2025）通过剪辑字幕和更高级别的摘要构建分层文本记忆。 其原始 EgoLife 实验改变了字幕生成器，在主评估中使用 GPT-4o 生成最终回答，并研究了基于 EgoGPT 的回答方式。 尽管 EgoGPT 经过了微调，但 EgoRAG 的分层检索过程本身并未引入参数优化；这也是它在我们的表格中被归入该组的基础。 原始论文未报告 LVBench 或 Video-MME（Long）的准确率。 因此，我们分别使用了 WorldMM 的 32.2 和 41.1 的结果。 WorldMM 识别出了一个专有主干模型，但未明确说明本次评估中字幕生成器与回答器的组合，因此两个模型条目均显示为“–”。

paragraphs.en: HippoMM ( Lin et al., 2026 ) segments audiovisual events, consolidates their multimodal representations, and switches between summary retrieval and detailed recall without method-specific gradient training. Its original implementation uses Qwen2.5-VL for visual descriptions and memory summaries, alongside ImageBind embeddings and Whisper transcripts. GPT-4o handles query classification; the revised paper also identifies it as the final answer synthesizer, whereas the initial appendix allows Qwen2.5-VL synthesis with GPT-4o for complex cases. Our model columns summarize these principal components, not a verified checkpoint pairing for WorldMM’s evaluation. The original paper does not report either benchmark in our table; 38.2 on LVBench and 41.6 on Video-MME (Long) are taken from WorldMM, which identifies a GPT backbone but does not specify its version.
paragraphs.zh: HippoMM（Lin 等人，2026）能够分割视听事件、整合其多模态表示，并在摘要检索与细节回忆之间切换，而无需针对特定方法进行梯度训练。 其原始实现使用 Qwen2.5-VL 进行视觉描述和记忆摘要，并结合 ImageBind 嵌入和 Whisper 转录文本。 GPT-4o 负责查询分类；修订后的论文还将其确定为最终答案合成器，而最初的附录则允许在复杂情况下由 Qwen2.5-VL 与 GPT-4o 协同合成。 我们的模型列总结了这些主要组件，而非 WorldMM 评估中经过验证的检查点组合。 原始论文并未报告我们表格中的任一基准测试；LVBench 上的 38.2 和 Video-MME（Long）上的 41.6 均引自 WorldMM，该研究识别出 GPT 作为主干模型，但未明确其版本。

paragraphs.en: For M3-Agent ( Long et al., 2026 ) , we use the original-paper result of 61.8 on Video-MME (Long), with a Qwen3-32B control policy and a Qwen2.5-Omni-7B memorization model. Memorization is trained with SFT and control with RL in separate stages. The memorization training data combine episodic annotations from Gemini 1.5 Pro and GPT-4o; these are data-synthesis teachers, not the deployed memory model. LVBench accuracy is not reported in this configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 M3-Agent（Long 等人，2026），我们使用原始论文中在 Video-MME（Long）上取得的 61.8 的结果，并搭配 Qwen3-32B 控制策略和 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 记忆模型。 记忆训练通过 SFT 完成，而控制则通过 RL 在单独的阶段进行训练。 记忆训练数据结合了来自 Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 GPT-4o 的事件性标注；这些数据是数据合成教师模型，而非实际部署的记忆模型。 在此配置下，LVBench 的准确率未被报告。

paragraphs.en: MemVid ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) trains its memorizer to generate memory-grounded retrieval clues through SFT followed by DPO using downstream generation feedback; its retriever and answer generator remain fixed. The reported configuration uses Qwen2-VL-7B as the generator and LanguageBind-Large for retrieval over 10-second moments, with 128 input frames for answering. From its original Tables 1 and 2, we retain LVBench 44.4 and only the with-subtitles Video-MME (Long) result of 57.1. KV-cache describes the memory representation, not a model name. The memorizer’s separate backbone is not explicitly identified, so its Memory Construction entry is “–” rather than an assumed QA backbone.
paragraphs.zh: MemVid（Yuan 等人，2025）通过 SFT 结合 DPO，利用下游生成反馈训练其记忆模块，以生成基于记忆的回查线索；其回查器和答案生成器保持固定不变。 所报告的配置使用 Qwen2-VL-7B 作为生成器，并使用 LanguageBind-Large 对 10 秒时长的片段进行回查，输入帧数为 128 帧用于回答。 从其原始的表 1 和表 2 中，我们保留了 LVBench 的 44.4，以及仅包含字幕的 Video-MME（Long）结果 57.1。 KV-cache 描述的是记忆表示方式，而非模型名称。 记忆模块的独立主干网络未被明确说明，因此其“记忆构建”条目显示为“–”，而非假设的问答主干网络。

paragraphs.en: Ego-R1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) trains a Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct controller with SFT and multi-turn RL over a preconstructed hierarchical memory; it does not jointly train memory construction. The original report gives 64.9 on Video-MME (Long). Its benchmark is labeled “w/o subtitle,” but Appendix B.3 describes Gemini 1.5 Pro captioning 30-second clips with visual content and transcribed dialogue, followed by GPT-4.1 aggregation into 10-minute summaries. This is therefore not a visual-only pipeline. It also uses proprietary visual tools and a separate summarization model. For compactness, the table lists only Gemini 1.5 Pro as the primary memory writer. The original report does not provide LVBench accuracy, so we supplement it with WorldMM’s 34.1. This evaluation uses the released controller checkpoint, changes the hierarchical memory timescales to 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 3 minutes, and 10 minutes, and caps reasoning at five iterations. Thus, the LVBench and Video-MME (Long) entries are from different evaluation configurations; the model columns summarize the original method rather than certify an identical pipeline for both scores.

paragraphs.en: WorldMM-GPT ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) uses GPT-5-mini to construct episodic and semantic memories, and GPT-5 for retrieval and answering. Memory captioning receives video frames and ASR transcripts. Its LVBench evaluation excludes 15 questions without temporal segment annotations, leaving 1,534 questions; its Video-MME (Long) evaluation contains 900 questions. These question sets also apply to the EgoRAG and HippoMM results taken from WorldMM, and the same LVBench subset applies to Ego-R1’s supplemented score. WorldMM aligns the hierarchical memory timescales of EgoRAG and Ego-R1 with its own, and otherwise follows official baseline specifications. Its retrieval agent and iterative baselines are limited to five iterations.
paragraphs.zh: WorldMM-GPT（Yeo 等人，2026）使用 GPT-5-mini 构建情节记忆和语义记忆，并使用 GPT-5 进行信息检索和回答问题。 记忆描述功能接收视频帧和自动语音识别（ASR）转录文本。 其 LVBench 评估排除了 15 个没有时间片段标注的问题，剩余 1,534 个问题；其 Video-MME（Long）评估包含 900 个问题。 这些问题集也适用于从 WorldMM 获取的 EgoRAG 和 HippoMM 结果，而相同的 LVBench 子集也适用于 Ego-R1 的补充得分。 WorldMM 将 EgoRAG 和 Ego-R1 的分层记忆时间尺度与自身的时间尺度对齐，其余部分则遵循官方基线规范。 其检索智能体和迭代基线被限制在五次迭代以内。

We retain each paper’s reported benchmark setting rather than assuming a common input modality or question subset.

paragraphs.en: The training-based VideoEvolve variant uses Qwen3.5-4B to select memory augmentations, a frozen Qwen3.8-27B Writer, and Qwen3-VL-8B for retrieval and answering. Its Memory Construction entry denotes the Writer, not the learnable Memory Evolver. Table 2 reports 58.9 on LVBench and 67.1 on Video-MME (Long) for this variant; the latter is not the full Video-MME score with subtitles. The training-free variant uses Qwen3.8-27B for both memory writing and retrieval, reaching 76.7 and 78.8 on the respective benchmarks. These are separate configurations, not a matched-backbone training ablation. Since frame budgets, transcript access, and question subsets have not been aligned across the listed systems, score differences provide descriptive cross-system comparisons rather than controlled measures of training or architectural gains.
paragraphs.zh: 基于训练的 VideoEvolve 变体使用 Qwen3.5-4B 来选择记忆增强内容，并使用一个冻结的 Qwen3.8-27B Writer 以及 Qwen3-VL-8B 进行检索和回答。 其“记忆构建”条目指的是 Writer，而非可学习的 Memory Evolver。 表 2 报告了该变体在 LVBench 上的得分为 58.9，在 Video-MME (Long) 上的得分为 67.1；后者并非包含字幕的完整 Video-MME 得分。 无训练版本的变体在记忆写入和检索中均使用 Qwen3.8-27B，在各自基准测试中的得分分别达到 76.7 和 78.8。 这些是独立的配置，而非基于相同主干网络的训练消融研究。 由于所列系统之间在帧预算、转录本访问权限和问题子集方面尚未对齐，因此得分差异只能提供描述性的跨系统比较，而非对训练或架构改进的受控测量。

paragraphs.en: The training-free VideoEvolve variant uses Base memory only: it does not run a memory-augmentation Controller or construct a Delta. Qwen3.8-27B serves as both the Base Writer and the tool-using Retrieval policy, without SFT, RL, or other task-specific parameter updates in this study. Base sampling and extraction follow Appendix A.1.1 , and question answering retains the stored-keyframe access, raw-video revisiting, and interaction budgets above. The LVBench and with-subtitles Video-MME Long evaluations use the same complete sets and subtitle inputs for Base construction as the training-based variant. Writer and Retrieval decoding is greedy, with a Retrieval context/output limit of 65,536/8,192 tokens. The fixed Base and index are reused for four question-answering runs with seeds { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\} ; we average their accuracies and apply the same technical-failure-only retry and full-coverage protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的 VideoEvolve 变体仅使用基础记忆：它不会运行记忆增强控制器，也不会构建 Delta。 在本研究中，Qwen3.8-27B 同时担任基础写作者和工具使用检索策略，且未进行 SFT、RL 或其他任务特定的参数更新。 基础采样与提取遵循附录 A.1.1，问答部分则保留上述已存储的关键帧访问、原始视频重看及交互预算。 LVBench 以及带字幕的 Video-MME Long 评估使用与基于训练的变体相同的基础构建完整数据集和字幕输入。 写作者与检索的解码采用贪心策略，检索上下文/输出限制为 65,536/8,192 个词元。 固定的基础模型和索引被重复用于四次问答运行，种子分别为 { 17 , 29 , 43 , 71 } \{17,29,43,71\}；我们对这些运行的准确率取平均值，并采用仅针对技术故障的重试及完全覆盖协议。

paragraphs.en: The supplementary experiments separate three questions: which observations to add to memory, which objective to use for policy optimization, and how to initialize the Retrieval Evolver before co-evolution. Tables 6 and 7 organize the first two questions into matching memory-construction and optimization-objective groups; Table 8 addresses the third. “Learned augmentation” and “Quality-first (ours)” report the full-model reference for the construction and objective ablations, respectively. Table 6 uses the corresponding Long-subset scores in Table 3 , while Table 7 reports the matching LongVideoBench Overall and LVBench scores. The two groups examine different aspects of the method; co-evolution and feedback ablations are reported separately in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 补充实验将三个问题分离出来：哪些观察结果应添加到记忆中，策略优化应使用哪个目标，以及在协同进化之前如何初始化检索演化器。 表6和表7将前两个问题分别组织为对应的记忆构建和优化目标组；表8则处理第三个问题。“学习增强”和“质量优先（我们的方法）”分别报告了构建和目标消融的完整模型参考结果。 表6使用了表3中相应的Long子集得分，而表7则报告了对应的LongVideoBench总体得分和LVBench得分。 这两个组别检验了该方法的不同方面；协同进化和反馈消融的结果在表3中单独报告。

paragraphs.en: “Memory evolution only” and “Retrieval evolution only” in Table 3 identify which policy is optimized, not which evidence is visible at inference. The feedback-free co-evolution comparison disables both BEF and CEF for joint and single-Evolver training, as described in the main text. By contrast, “w/o video revisiting” changes question-time access to new source frames. It is distinct from “Base memory only” in the construction group, which omits the Delta but retains the Base records and saved keyframes. Thus, memory evolution, memory augmentation, and memory-only inference denote different interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 表3中的“仅记忆演化”和“仅检索演化”用于明确优化的是哪种策略，而非推理阶段可见的是哪些证据。 如正文所述，无反馈的协同演化比较在联合训练和单智能体演化训练中同时禁用了BEF和CEF。 相比之下，“无视频重访”则改变了问题提出时对新源帧的访问方式。 这与构建组中的“仅基础记忆”不同：后者省略了Delta，但保留了基础记录和已保存的关键帧。 因此，记忆演化、记忆增强和仅记忆推理代表了不同的干预方式。

sents.zh: 因此，记忆演化、记忆增强和仅记忆推理代表了不同的干预方式。

paragraphs.en: In Table 3 , “Base (no evolution)” pairs Base-plus-Delta memory from the initial Controller with the Retrieval policy after both SFT stages; neither policy has undergone co-evolution. “Memory evolution only” freezes this post-SFT Retrieval policy, while “Retrieval evolution only” keeps the initial Controller and its Base-plus-Delta memory fixed. The two single-policy variants and the four evolution-guidance variants start from the full method’s initializations, update their active policies for four rounds, and use the third-round checkpoints for evaluation; inactive policies remain at their initial checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 在表3中，“Base（无演化）”将初始控制器的 Base-plus-Delta 记忆与两个 SFT 阶段后的检索策略进行配对；这两种策略均未经过协同演化。“仅记忆演化”则冻结了此 SFT 后的检索策略，而“仅检索演化”则保持初始控制器及其 Base-plus-Delta 记忆不变。 两种单一策略变体和四种演化引导变体均从完整方法的初始化设置开始，对其活跃策略进行四轮更新，并使用第三轮的检查点进行评估；非活跃策略则保持在其初始检查点上。

sents.en: In Table 3 , “Base (no evolution)” pairs Base-plus-Delta memory from the initial Controller with the Retrieval policy after both SFT stages; neither policy has undergone co-evolution. “Memory evolution only” freezes this post-SFT Retrieval policy, while “Retrieval evolution only” keeps the initial Controller and its Base-plus-Delta memory fixed.
sents.zh: 在表3中，“Base（无演化）”将初始控制器的 Base-plus-Delta 记忆与两个 SFT 阶段后的检索策略进行配对；这两种策略均未经过协同演化。“仅记忆演化”则冻结了此 SFT 后的检索策略，而“仅检索演化”则保持初始控制器及其 Base-plus-Delta 记忆不变。

sents.en: The two single-policy variants and the four evolution-guidance variants start from the full method’s initializations, update their active policies for four rounds, and use the third-round checkpoints for evaluation; inactive policies remain at their initial checkpoints.

paragraphs.en: For “w/o alternating updates”, all Controller training is completed with Retrieval frozen; its resulting memory is then fixed throughout the subsequent Retrieval training stage. The initializations and cumulative per-policy update budgets match the full method’s four-round training, but evaluation uses the endpoints of the two sequential stages. BEF is disabled and CEF is retained. This variant therefore changes the update ordering and removes dynamic cross-policy allocation while retaining capability-guided sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 在“无交替更新”的情况下，所有控制器的训练均在检索模块冻结的状态下完成；由此产生的记忆将在随后的检索训练阶段中保持不变。 初始化和各策略的累计更新预算与完整方法的四轮训练一致，但评估使用的是两个连续阶段的最终状态。 BEF 被禁用，而 CEF 则保留。 因此，该变体改变了更新顺序，并移除了动态跨策略分配，同时保留了能力引导的采样机制。

paragraphs.en: For “w/o BEF”, the Memory and Retrieval allocation shares remain fixed at 50% each throughout training; this does not require equal numbers of groups on the two sides. For “w/o CEF”, sampling is uniform over all training videos on the Memory side and all training questions on the Retrieval side, without capability-demand or frontier weighting. In contrast, “w/o frontier diagnosis” retains capability-demand weights but samples uniformly within the selected capability, removing the frontier/exploration/retention partition.
paragraphs.zh: 对于“w/o BEF”，记忆与检索的分配份额在整个训练过程中均固定为各 50%；这并不要求两侧的智能体数量相等。 对于“w/o CEF”，在记忆侧对所有训练视频进行均匀采样，在检索侧对所有训练问题进行均匀采样，且不加能力需求或前沿加权。 相比之下，“w/o frontier diagnosis”保留了能力需求权重，但在选定的能力范围内进行均匀采样，从而移除了前沿/探索/保留的划分。

paragraphs.en: All of these core variants permit raw-video revisiting at evaluation, including Base (no evolution) and the sequential-training variant. Textual memory and saved keyframes remain accessible.

paragraphs.en: Memory construction. In the construction groups of Tables 6 and 7 , all four strategies are evaluated with the same fixed Retrieval checkpoint used by the full model in the main experiments; Retrieval is not retrained for each memory variant. Learned augmentation also uses the full model’s co-evolved Memory Controller checkpoint. All four variants permit raw-video revisiting at question time, including Base memory only, which removes the Delta rather than disabling view_video .
paragraphs.zh: 记忆构建。 在表 6 和表 7 的构建组中，所有四种策略均使用主实验中完整模型所采用的相同固定检索检查点进行评估；每种记忆变体均未对检索进行重新训练。 学习到的增强也使用了完整模型协同演化的记忆控制器检查点。 所有四种变体都允许在提问时重新查看原始视频，包括仅包含基础记忆的变体，该变体移除了 Delta，而非禁用 view_video。

sents.en: Memory construction.
sents.zh: 记忆构建。

sents.en: In the construction groups of Tables 6 and 7 , all four strategies are evaluated with the same fixed Retrieval checkpoint used by the full model in the main experiments; Retrieval is not retrained for each memory variant.

paragraphs.en: Table 6(a) compares augmentation strategies under the same observation budget within this ablation group. Learned augmentation achieves the highest accuracy on both Long subsets. Random and uniform augmentation yield smaller gains, suggesting that observation selection matters beyond simply adding observations to the Base Memory.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6(a) 比较了该消融组内在相同观察预算下的增强策略。 在两个 Long 子集上，学习到的增强方法都实现了最高的准确率。 随机和均匀增强带来的提升较小，这表明观察选择的重要性不仅限于简单地向基础记忆中添加观察。

sents.zh: 表 6(a) 比较了该消融组内在相同观察预算下的增强策略。

sents.zh: 在两个 Long 子集上，学习到的增强方法都实现了最高的准确率。

paragraphs.en: The learned strategy selects the Macro, temporal region, frame level, and extraction focus through the interface in Appendix A.1.2 . The uniform and random rows provide alternative observation-selection strategies, whereas Base memory only adds no supplemental records. The shared budget is an allowance for augmentation, not a claim that every strategy consumes the same number of frames or has equal runtime; the learned construction policy can stop before exhausting it. Learning the selection policy also does not mean fine-tuning the Writer, which remains frozen.

paragraphs.en: Uniform augmentation places observations at evenly spaced locations along the full video timeline. It requests eight frames at each location and uses the same generic description instruction for the Writer. Under normal execution, it continues until the observation budget is exhausted, without content-dependent early stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 均匀增强将观察点放置在完整视频时间轴上等间距的位置。 它在每个位置请求八帧，并对“Writer”使用相同的通用描述指令。 在正常执行过程中，它会持续运行直到观察预算耗尽，而不会因内容依赖的原因提前停止。

sents.en: Uniform augmentation places observations at evenly spaced locations along the full video timeline.
sents.zh: 均匀增强将观察点放置在完整视频时间轴上等间距的位置。

paragraphs.en: Random augmentation follows the same evenly spaced placement rule and generic Writer instruction as the uniform baseline. At each step, it samples uniformly from STOP and the budget-feasible frame levels in { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\} , excluding levels that exceed the remaining frame budget before sampling. Selecting STOP terminates construction; otherwise, the sampled frame level is requested at the scheduled location. This baseline therefore randomizes the frame level and stopping decision, rather than observation placement or extraction focus. No random seed is explicitly fixed for construction; the resulting memory is held fixed across the four question-answering runs.
paragraphs.zh: 随机增强遵循与均匀基线相同的等间距放置规则和通用 Writer 指令。 在每一步中，它从 STOP 和集合 { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } \{2,4,8,16\} 中的预算可行帧级别进行均匀采样，但在采样前会排除超出剩余帧预算的级别。 选择 STOP 将终止构建过程；否则，将在预定位置请求所采样的帧级别。 因此，该基线对帧级别和停止决策进行了随机化，而非观察放置或提取焦点。 构建过程未显式固定随机种子；由此产生的记忆在四次问答运行中保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Optimization objective. For each alternative objective in Tables 6 and 7 , both the Memory Controller and Retrieval policy are retrained from the same initializations as the full method for four co-evolution rounds. Each variant is evaluated with its paired third-round checkpoints, following the same fixed-round selection rule as the full method. BEF and CEF remain enabled and operate on each run’s diagnostic results. All objective variants permit raw-video revisiting during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 优化目标。 对于表 6 和表 7 中的每个替代目标，记忆控制器和检索策略均使用与完整方法相同的初始化参数，经过四轮协同进化后重新训练。 每个变体均使用其对应的第三轮检查点进行评估，并遵循与完整方法相同的固定轮次选择规则。 BEF 和 CEF 始终保持启用状态，并对每次运行的诊断结果进行操作。 所有目标变体在评估期间均允许重新访问原始视频。

paragraphs.en: Table 6(b) compares the quality-first objective with alternative reward designs on the Long subsets of Video-MME and LongVideoBench. Removing the regression penalty reduces accuracy by 2.2/3.1 points, and a scalar quality–efficiency reward also underperforms the full objective. Quality-first optimization improves over quality-only group-relative optimization by 0.9 and 1.2 points, respectively. These accuracy results support the objective design, but do not by themselves establish an efficiency advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6(b) 在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 的 Long 子集上比较了以质量为首要目标的方案与其他奖励设计。 移除回归惩罚会使准确率下降 2.2/3.1 分，而标量化的质量-效率奖励表现也逊于完整目标函数。 以质量为首要目标的优化方案分别比仅关注质量的组内相对优化提升了 0.9 分和 1.2 分。 这些准确率结果支持了该目标函数的设计，但本身并不能证明其具有效率优势。

sents.en: Table 6(b) compares the quality-first objective with alternative reward designs on the Long subsets of Video-MME and LongVideoBench.
sents.zh: 表 6(b) 在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 的 Long 子集上比较了以质量为首要目标的方案与其他奖励设计。

paragraphs.en: The full quality-first objective is specified in Appendix A.4 : task-quality advantages are computed first, and the bounded efficiency preference is applied only among eligible, equal-quality trajectories. It does not subtract a resource penalty from the task reward before group normalization. The objective ablation therefore distinguishes the construction regression term, task-quality learning, and the placement of the efficiency preference. These are training signals: the reported endpoint remains multiple-choice accuracy, not a quality–cost reward or a score for the reasoning text. The underlying resource quantities are supplemental frame inputs and accepted text for construction, and executed tools and newly acquired frames for retrieval; they are not end-to-end latency measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的“质量优先”目标在附录 A.4 中有详细说明：首先计算任务质量优势，而受限效率偏好仅适用于符合条件的、质量相等的轨迹。 它在进行组内归一化之前，不会从任务奖励中扣除资源惩罚项。 因此，该目标消融分析区分了构建回归项、任务质量学习以及效率偏好的应用位置。 这些是训练信号：所报告的最终指标仍然是多选准确率，而非质量-成本奖励或推理文本的得分。 其底层资源量包括用于构建的补充帧输入和已接受的文本，以及用于检索的执行工具和新获取的帧；它们并非端到端的延迟测量值。

paragraphs.en: Cold-start initialization. This ablation changes the Retrieval Evolver’s initialization before Agentic RL, not whether co-evolution is subsequently performed. The Memory Evolver does not undergo either cold-start SFT stage, and the Writer remains frozen. paragraphs.en: Two-stage SFT provides a crucial foundation for subsequent co-evolution (Table 8 ). Without cold-start SFT, LVBench accuracy falls from 58.9% to 32.8% despite retaining co-evolution. Removing Stage I or Stage II reduces it to 54.2% or 40.6%, respectively. The larger loss without Stage II highlights the contribution of broader visual-trajectory supervision, while the additional benefit of Stage I supports tool-use initialization. Together, the two stages provide a stronger starting point than either stage alone.
paragraphs.zh: 两阶段 SFT 为后续协同进化提供了至关重要的基础（表 8）。 如果没有冷启动 SFT，尽管保留了协同进化，LVBench 的准确率仍会从 58.9% 下降到 32.8%。 移除第一阶段或第二阶段后，准确率分别降至 54.2% 或 40.6%。 缺少第二阶段时损失更大，这凸显了更广泛的视觉轨迹监督所做出的贡献，而第一阶段带来的额外收益则支持了工具使用的初始化。 两个阶段共同作用，比单独使用任一阶段都能提供更强的起点。

paragraphs.en: Although VideoEvolve improves long-video understanding through memory–retrieval co-evolution, several limitations remain. First, the reported evaluation focuses on offline multiple-choice video understanding; it does not establish effectiveness for streaming video, open-ended dialogue, or tasks requiring direct audio understanding. Second, the framework depends on the perceptual quality of the frozen Writer and the evidence available within finite observation budgets. Learned augmentation and selective revisiting may still miss brief events or subtle visual details, while source-linked records and valid citations do not guarantee factual correctness. Third, policy optimization relies on ground-truth answers, and BEF/CEF scheduling uses a fixed diagnostic pool and a predefined capability taxonomy. These signals cover only the questions and capabilities represented in the available data; bottleneck estimates are operational proxies rather than causal attributions of failure. Finally, alternating training requires candidate rollouts, frozen-policy scoring, and repeated memory and index reconstruction. At inference, reusable memory amortizes construction across questions, but multi-step retrieval and optional video revisiting still incur computation. The resource proxies used in our objective do not directly measure end-to-end latency or hardware cost.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 VideoEvolve 通过记忆与检索的协同进化提升了长视频的理解能力，但仍存在若干局限性。 首先，所报告的评估集中于离线的视频多项选择题理解；它并未证明该方法在流式视频、开放式对话或需要直接音频理解的任务中的有效性。 其次，该框架依赖于已冻结的 Writer 的感知质量以及有限观察预算内可获得的信息证据。 经过学习的增强和选择性回溯可能仍会遗漏短暂事件或细微的视觉细节，而来源关联的记录和有效引用也无法保证事实正确性。 第三，策略优化依赖真实答案，而 BEF/CEF 调度则使用固定的诊断池和预定义的能力分类体系。 这些信号仅覆盖可用数据中所体现的问题和能力；瓶颈估计是操作上的代理指标，而非失败的因果归因。 最后，交替训练需要候选执行流程、冻结策略评分，以及重复的记忆与索引重建。 在推理阶段，可重用的记忆可在多个问题间摊销构建成本，但多步检索和可选的视频回溯仍会产生计算开销。 我们目标函数中使用的资源代理指标并未直接衡量端到端的延迟或硬件成本。

paragraphs.en: Future work can extend VideoEvolve along these directions. Incremental memory updates for streaming inputs, together with richer audiovisual evidence and open-ended evaluation, would broaden the settings in which co-evolution can be studied. Evidence-level verification and calibrated uncertainty could help identify unreliable memory records and determine when additional observation or abstention is appropriate. Another direction is to combine weaker supervision with adaptive capability discovery, reducing dependence on fixed labeled pools while explicitly validating the reliability of the resulting feedback. More efficient memory and index updates, policy distillation, and cost-aware execution could reduce training and deployment overhead. Such extensions should be assessed with end-to-end measurements that separate preprocessing, training, and question-time costs, alongside broader evaluation across video durations, domains, and backbone models.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作可以沿着这些方向扩展 VideoEvolve。 对流式输入进行增量式记忆更新，并结合更丰富的视听证据与开放式的评估，将扩大共进化研究所能应用的环境范围。 证据层面的验证与校准后的不确定性估计，有助于识别不可靠的记忆记录，并判断何时应进行额外观察或选择弃权。 另一个方向是将较弱的监督机制与自适应能力发现相结合，从而减少对固定标签池的依赖，同时明确验证所生成反馈的可靠性。 更高效记忆与索引更新、策略蒸馏以及成本感知的执行方式，可以降低训练与部署的开销。 此类扩展应通过端到端的测量进行评估，该测量需区分预处理、训练和提问时的成本，并同时在视频时长、领域及基础模型方面进行更广泛的评估。
